---- 输出列解析 ----\n        List<String> outputColumns = resolveOutputColumns(spec.select(), table);\n\n        // ---- 构建执行计划 ----\n        PlanNode scan = new PlanNode(\"SCAN\", \"table=\" + table.name());\n        PlanNode root = scan;\n        if (spec.filter() != null) {\n            PlanNode filter = new PlanNode(\"FILTER\", abbreviate(spec.filter()));\n            filter.addChild(root);\n            root = filter;\n        }\n        PlanNode project = new PlanNode(\"PROJECT\", \"columns=\" + String.join(\", \", outputColumns));\n        project.addChild(root);\n        root = project;\n        if (spec.limit() != null) {\n            PlanNode limit = new PlanNode(\"LIMIT\", \"limit=\" + spec.limit());\n            limit.addChild(root);\n            root = limit;\n        }\n\n        // ---- 执行 ----\n        List<Row> source = table.rows();\n        scan.setRowsIn(source.size());\n        scan.setRowsOut(source.size());\n\n        List<Row> current = source;\n        long matched = source.size();\n        if (spec.filter() != null) {\n            List<Row> kept = new ArrayList<>();\n            for (Row row : current) {\n                Tri tri = evaluator.evalPredicate(spec.filter(), row);\n                if (tri == Tri.TRUE) {\n                    kept.add(row);\n                }\n            }\n            PlanNode filterNode = root.kind().equals(\"LIMIT\")\n                    ? root.children().get(0) : root;\n            // root 此时是 PROJECT；FILTER 在其唯一子节点\n            filterNode = findNode(filterNode, \"FILTER\");\n            filterNode.setRowsIn(current.size());\n            filterNode.setRowsOut(kept.size());\n            current = kept;\n            matched = kept.size();\n        }\n\n        List<Row> projected = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (Row row : current) {\n            Row pruned = new Row();\n            for (String col : outputColumns) {\n                pruned.set(col, row.get(col));\n            }\n            projected.add(pruned);\n        }\n        PlanNode projectNode = findNode(root, \"PROJECT\");\n        projectNode.setRowsIn(current.size());\n        projectNode.setRowsOut(projected.size());\n        current = projected;\n\n        if (spec.limit() != null) {\n            long lim = spec.limit();\n            List<Row> limited = lim >= current.size()\n                    ? current\n                    : new ArrayList<>(current.subList(0, (int) lim));\n            PlanNode limitNode = findNode(root, \"LIMIT\");\n            limitNode.setRowsIn(current.size());\n            limitNode.setRowsOut(limited.size());\n            current = limited;\n        }\n\n        return new QueryResult(outputColumns, current, root, source.size(), matched);\n    }\n\n    private static List<String> resolveOutputColumns(List<String> select, Table table) {\n        if (select == null || select.isEmpty()\n                || (select.size() == 1 && \"*\".equals(select.get(0)))) {\n            return new ArrayList<>(table.columns().keySet());\n        }\n        for (String col : select) {\n            if (\"*\".equals(col)) {\n                throw new EngineException(\"'*' cannot be combined with explicit columns\");\n            }\n            if (!table.columns().containsKey(col)) findNode(PlanNode root, String kind) {\n        if (root.kind().equals(kind)) return root;\n        for (PlanNode child : root.children()) {\n            PlanNode found = findNode(child, kind);\n            if (found != null) return found;\n        }\n        return null;\n    }\n\n    private static String abbreviate(ExprHolder expr) {\n        return expr.text();\n    }\n\n    /** 让计划中能展示表达式原文；由 tvl.engine;\n\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.List;\n\nimport tvl.evaluator.Evaluator;\nimport tvl.expr.Tri;\n\n/**\n * 单机内存查询引擎：不依赖任何 SQL/关系引擎，直接在 {@link Catalog} 的内存行上执行。\n *\n * 执行管线（自底向上）：\n * SCAN -> FILTER（3VL：仅 TRUE 通过，FALSE/UNKNOWN 均被剔除）-> PROJECT -> LIMIT。\n * 每个节点记录 rowsIn/rowsOut，形成可导出的执行计划。\n */\npublic final class QueryEngine {\n\n    private final Catalog catalog;\n    private final Evaluator evaluator = new Evaluator();\n\n    public QueryEngine(Catalog catalog) {\n        this.catalog = catalog;\n    }\n\n    public QueryResult execute(QuerySpec spec) {\n        Table table = catalog.get(spec.table());\n        if (table == null) {\n            throw new EngineException(\"unknown table '\" + spec.table() + \"'\");\n        }\n\n        // ---- 输出列解析 ----\n        List<String> outputColumns = resolveOutputColumns(spec.select(), table);\n\n        // ---- 构建执行计划 ----\n        PlanNode scan = new PlanNode(\"SCAN\", \"table=\" + table.name());\n        PlanNode root = scan;\n        if (spec.filter() != null) {\n            PlanNode filter = new PlanNode(\"FILTER\", abbreviate(spec.filter()));\n            filter.addChild(root);\n            root = filter;\n        }\n        PlanNode project = new PlanNode(\"PROJECT\", \"columns=\" + String.join(\", \", outputColumns));\n        project.addChild(root);\n        root = project;\n        if (spec.limit() != null) {\n            PlanNode limit = new PlanNode(\"LIMIT\", \"limit=\" + spec.limit());\n            limit.addChild(root);\n            root = limit;\n        }\n\n        // ---- 执行 ----\n        List<Row> source = table.rows();\n        scan.setRowsIn(source.size());\n        scan.setRowsOut(source.size());\n\n        List<Row> current = source;\n        long matched = source.size();\n        if (spec.filter() != null) {\n            List<Row> kept = new ArrayList<>();\n            for (Row row : current) {\n                Tri tri = evaluator.evalPredicate(spec.filter(), row);\n                if (tri == Tri.TRUE) {\n                    kept.add(row);\n                }\n            }\n            PlanNode filterNode = root.kind().equals(\"LIMIT\")\n                    ? root.children().get(0) : root;\n            // root 此时是 PROJECT；FILTER 在其唯一子节点\n            filterNode = findNode(filterNode, \"FILTER\");\n            filterNode.setRowsIn(current.size());\n            filterNode.setRowsOut(kept.size());\n            current = kept;\n            matched = kept.size();\n        }\n\n        List<Row> projected = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (Row row : current) {\n            Row pruned = new Row();\n            for (String col : outputColumns) {\n                pruned.set(col, row.get(col));\n            }\n            projected.add(pruned);\n        }\n        PlanNode projectNode = findNode(root, \"PROJECT\");\n        projectNode.setRowsIn(current.size());\n        projectNode.setRowsOut(projected.size());\n        current = projected;\n\n        if (spec.limit() != null) {\n            long lim = spec.limit();\n            List<Row> limited = lim >= current.size()\n                    ? current\n                    : new ArrayList<>(current.subList(0, (int) lim));\n            PlanNode limitNode = findNode(root, \"LIMIT\");\n            limitNode.setRowsIn(current.size());\n            limitNode.setRowsOut(limited.size());\n            current = limited;\n        }\n\n        return new QueryResult(outputColumns, current, root, source.size(), matched);\n    }\n\n    private static List<String> resolveOutputColumns(List<String> select, Table table) {\n        if (select == null || select.isEmpty()\n                || (select.size() == 1 && \"*\".equals(select.get(0)))) {\n            return new ArrayList<>(table.columns().keySet());\n        }\n        for (String col : select) {\n            if (\"*\".equals(col)) {\n                throw new EngineException(\"'*' cannot be combined with explicit columns\");\n            }\n            if (!table.columns().containsKey(col)) {\n                throw new EngineException(\"unknown output column '\" + col + \"'\");\n            }\n        }\n        return new ArrayList<>(select);\n    }\n\n    private static PlanNode findNode(PlanNode root, String kind) {\n        if (root.kind().equals(kind)) return root;\n        for (PlanNode child : root.children()) {\n            PlanNode found = findNode(child, kind);\n            if (found != null) return found;\n        }\n        return null;\n    }\n\n    private static String abbreviate(ExprHolder expr) {\n        return expr.text();\n    }\n\n    /** 让计划中能展示表达式原文；由 QuerySpec 的 filter 包装。 */\n    @FunctionalInterface\n    public interface ExprHolder {\n        String text();\n    }\n}\n","userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"eba2fca1-ff43-4076-90b3-50b3c57352a3","session_id":"0bae1d86-80df-45f1-8b2f-c35225e023c1","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp11/b","sessionId":"0bae1d86-80df-45f1-8b2f-c35225e023c1","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp11-b","slug":"starry-churning-cookie"}

1 AND\n *         ^\n * </pre>\n */\npublic final class ErrorFormatter {\n\n    private ErrorFormatter() {\n    }\n\n    /** @return 长度为 3 的数组：[line(1-based), column(1-based), 带 ^ 指示符的两行片段] */\n    public static int[] lineAndColumn(String source, int pos) {\n        int line = 1;\n        int column = 1;\n        int safePos = Math.max(0, Math.min(pos, source.length()));\n        for (int i = 0; i < safePos; i++) {\n            if (source.charAt(i) == '\\n') {\n                line++;\n                column = 1;\n            } else {\n                column++;\n            }\n        }\n        return new int[]{line, column};\n    }\n\n    /** 生成 \"源码行\\n   ^\" 形式的定位片段（只处理单行表达式的常见情形）。 */\n    public static String caret(String source, int pos) {\n        int safePos = Math.max(0, Math.min(pos, source.length()));\n        int lineStart = source.lastIndexOf('\\n', safePos - 1) + 1;\n        int lineEnd = source.indexOf('\\n', safePos);\n        if (lineEnd < 0) lineEnd = source.length();\n        String line = source.substring(lineStart, lineEnd);\n        int offsetInLine = safePos - lineStart;\n        return line + \"\\n\" + \" \".repeat(offsetInLine) + \"^\";\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_cd4eb85588cabbf567131b21","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":2308,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":56120,"output_tokens":809,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_rt0p7cmh9ecrl91oq5zn0o4v":{"content":"package tvl.api;\n\n/**\n * 把表达式错误的字符偏移量转换为行/列与可视化指示符。\n * 例如：\n * <pre>\n * a &gt; {"parentUuid":"1eb46456-8529-4f91-afb7-8c1b2fdd0bac","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_3tsg4csvdffebe2ijdy6wak6","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp11/b/src/tvl/api/JsonApi.java","content":"package tvl.api;\n\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.LinkedHashMap;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\nimport tvl.analyzer.DataType;\nimport tvl.analyzer.Schema;\nimport tvl.analyzer.TypeChecker;\nimport tvl.analyzer.TypeException;\nimport tvl.engine.Catalog;\nimport tvl.engine.EngineException;\nimport tvl.engine.QueryEngine;\nimport tvl.engine.QueryResult;\nimport tvl.engine.QuerySpec;\nimport tvl.engine.Row;\nimport tvl.engine.Table;\nimport tvl.evaluator.EvalException;\nimport tvl.expr.Expr;\nimport tvl.expr.ExpressionException;\nimport tvl.json.JsonException;\nimport tvl.lexer.LexException;\nimport tvl.parser.ParseException;\nimport tvl.parser.Parser;\n\n/**\n * JSON 请求入口（核心）：纯函数式分发器，与 HTTP/CLI 传输方式无关。\n *\n * 支持三种 action：\n * <ul>\n *   <li>{@code load}   —— 装载/替换一张内存表（含严格类型校验）</li>\n *   <li>{@code query}  —— 解析 + 类型检查 + 执行表达式查询，返回行、统计与执行计划</li>\n *   <li>{@code export} —— 导出全部数据（以及表结构），用于持久化</li>\n * </ul>\n *\n * 输入/输出均为可 JSON 序列化的 Java 标准类型（Map/List/String/Long/Boolean）。\n */\npublic final class JsonApi {\n\n    private final Catalog catalog;\n    private final QueryEngine engine;\n\n    public JsonApi() {\n        this(new Catalog());\n    }\n\n    public JsonApi(Catalog catalog) {\n        this.catalog = catalog;\n        this.engine = new QueryEngine(catalog);\n    }\n\n    public Catalog catalog() {\n        return catalog;\n    }\n\n    /** 处理一个已解析的 JSON 请求对象。 */\n    public Map<String, Object> handle(Map<String, Object> request) {\n        try {\n            Object actionValue = request.get(\"action\");\n            if (!(actionValue instanceof String action)) {\n                return error(\"INVALID_REQUEST\", \"missing or invalid 'action' field\", null);\n            }\n            return switch (action) {\n                case \"load\" -> handleLoad(request);\n                case \"query\" -> handleQuery(request);\n                case \"export\" -> handleExport(request);\n                default -> error(\"INVALID_REQUEST\",\n                        \"unknown action '\" + action + \"' (expected load|query|export)\", null);\n            };\n        } catch (ApiException ex) {\n            return error(ex.code, ex.getMessage(), ex.detail);\n        } catch (ExpressionException ex) {\n            // 词法/语法/类型/求值错误理论上已在各自处理方法中包装，这里兜底\n            return error(\"EXPRESSION_ERROR\", ex.getMessage(), null);\n        } catch (EngineException ex) {\n            return error(\"ENGINE_ERROR\", ex.getMessage(), null);\n        }\n    }\n\n    /** 处理原始 JSON 字符串。 */\n    public String handleJson(String json) {\n        try {\n            Object parsed = tvl.json.Json.parse(json);\n            if (!(parsed instanceof Map<?, ?> rawMap)) {\n                return tvl.json.Json.write(error(\"INVALID_REQUEST\",\n                        \"request body must be a JSON object\", null));\n            }\n            @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n            Map<String, Object> request = (Map<String, Object>) rawMap;\n            return tvl.json.Json.write(handle(request));\n        } catch (JsonException ex) {\n            return tvl.json.Json.write(error(\"INVALID_JSON\",\n                    ex.getMessage() + \" (offset \" + ex.position + \")\", null));\n        }\n    }\n\n    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // load\n    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    private Map<String, Object> handleLoad(Map<String, Object> request) {\n        String tableName = requireString(request, \"table\");\n        if (tableName.isBlank()) {\n            throw new ApiException(\"INVALID_REQUEST\", \"'table' must be a non-empty string\", null);\n        }\n        List<?> columnsRaw = requireList(request, \"columns\");\n        List<?> rowsRaw = optList(request, \"rows\");\n\n        Table table = new Table(tableName);\n        List<String> columnNames = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (int i = 0; i < columnsRaw.size(); i++) {\n            Object c = columnsRaw.get(i);\n            if (!(c instanceof Map<?, ?> cm)) {\n                throw new ApiException(\"INVALID_REQUEST\",\n                        \"columns[\" + i + \"] must be an object {name,type}\", null);\n            }\n            Object name = cm.get(\"name\");\n            Object type = cm.get(\"type\");\n            if (!(name instanceof String colName) || colName.isBlank()) {\n                throw new ApiException(\"INVALID_REQUEST\",\n                        \"columns[\" + i + \"].name must be a non-empty string\", null);\n            }\n            if (!(type instanceof String typeName)) {\n                throw new ApiException(\"INVALID_REQUEST\",\n                        \"columns[\" + i + \"].type must be a string\", null);\n            }\n            DataType dataType = parseTypeName(typeName);\n            if (dataType == null) {\n                throw new ApiException(\"INVALID_REQUEST\",\n                        \"columns[\" + i + \"].type '\" + typeName\n                                + \"' is not supported (use INTEGER|STRING|BOOLEAN)\", null);\n            }\n            if (columnNames.contains(colName)) {\n                throw new ApiException(\"INVALID_REQUEST\",\n                        \"duplicate column '\" + colName + \"'\", null);\n            }\n            columnNames.add(colName);\n            table.addColumn(colName, dataType);\n        }\n        if (columnNames.isEmpty()) {\n            throw new ApiException(\"INVALID_REQUEST\", \"table must define at least one column\", null);\n        }\n\n        List<Row> parsedRows = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (int ri = 0; ri < rowsRaw.size(); ri++) {\n            Object ro = rowsRaw.get(ri);\n            if (!(ro instanceof Map<?, ?> rm)) {\n                throw new ApiException(\"TYPE_MISMATCH\",\n                        \"rows[\" + ri + \"] must be an object\", null);\n            }\n            Row row = new Row();\n            for (String col : columnNames) {\n                if (!rm.containsKey(col)) {\n                    throw new ApiException(\"TYPE_MISMATCH\",\n                            \"rows[\" + ri + \"] is missing column '\" + col + \"'\", null);\n                }\n                Object value = rm.get(col);\n                DataType expected = table.typeOf(col);\n                row.set(col, coerceValue(value, expected, \"rows[\" + ri + \"].\" + col));\n            }\n            for (Object extraKey : rm.keySet()) {\n                if (!columnNames.contains(extraKey)) {\n                    throw new ApiException(\"TYPE_MISMATCH\",\n                            \"rows[\" + ri + \"] has unknown column '\" + extraKey + \"'\", null);\n                }\n            }\n            parsedRows.add(row);\n        }\n        for (Row r : parsedRows) {\n            table.addRow(r);\n        }\n\n        catalog.put(table);\n\n        Map<String, Object> result = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        result.put(\"ok\", true);\n        result.put(\"action\", \"load\");\n        result.put(\"table\", tableName);\n        result.put(\"columnsLoaded\", columnNames.size());\n        result.put(\"rowsLoaded\", table.rowCount());\n        return result;\n    }\n\n    private Object coerceValue(Object value, DataType expected, String path) {\n        if (value == null) {\n            return null; // SQL NULL\n        }\n        switch (expected) {\n            case INTEGER:\n                if (value instanceof Long l) return l;\n                if (value instanceof Integer i) return i.longValue();\n                throw new ApiException(\"TYPE_MISMATCH\",\n                        path + \" expects INTEGER but got \" + jsonKind(value), null);\n            case STRING:\n                if (value instanceof String s) return s;\n                throw new ApiException(\"TYPE_MISMATCH\",\n                        path + \" expects STRING but got \" + jsonKind(value), null);\n            case BOOLEAN:\n                if (value instanceof Boolean b) return b;\n                throw new ApiException(\"TYPE_MISMATCH\",\n                        path + \" expects BOOLEAN but got \" + jsonKind(value), null);\n            default:\n                throw new ApiException(\"TYPE_MISMATCH\",\n                        path + \" has unsupported declared type \" + expected.displayName(), null);\n        }\n    }\n\n    private static String jsonKind(Object value) {\n        if (value instanceof Long || value instanceof Integer) return \"INTEGER\";\n        if (value instanceof String) return \"STRING\";\n        if (value instanceof Boolean) return \"BOOLEAN\";\n        if (value instanceof Double) return \"FLOAT (only integer literals are supported)\";\n        return value.getClass().getSimpleName();\n    }\n\n    private static DataType parseTypeName(String name) {\n        return switch (name.trim().toUpperCase()) {\n            case \"INTEGER\", \"INT\", \"BIGINT\" -> DataType.INTEGER;\n            case \"STRING\", \"TEXT\", \"VARCHAR\" -> DataType.STRING;\n            case \"BOOLEAN\", \"BOOL\" -> DataType.BOOLEAN;\n            default -> null;\n        };\n    }\n\n    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // query\n    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    private Map<String, Object> handleQuery(Map<String, Object> request) {\n        String tableName = requireString(request, \"table\");\n        Table table = catalog.get(tableName);\n        if (table == null) {\n            throw new ApiException(\"UNKNOWN_TABLE\", \"unknown table '\" + tableName + \"'\", null);\n        }\n\n        String whereText = optString(request, \"where\");\n        Expr filter = null;\n        if (whereText != null && !whereText.isBlank()) {\n            filter = compileExpression(whereText, table);\n        }\n\n        List<String> select = null;\n        if (request.get(\"select\") != null) {\n            List<?> selectRaw = requireList(request, \"select\");\n            select = new ArrayList<>();\n            for (int i = 0; i < selectRaw.size(); i++) {\n                Object o = selectRaw.get(i);\n                if (!(o instanceof String s)) {\n                    throw new ApiException(\"INVALID_REQUEST\",\n                            \"select[\" + i + \"] must be a column name string\", null);\n                }\n                select.add(s);\n            }\n        }\n\n        Long limit = null;\n        Object limitValue = request.get(\"limit\");\n        if (limitValue != null) {\n            if (!(limitValue instanceof Long lim)) {\n                throw new ApiException(\"INVALID_REQUEST\", \"'limit' must be an integer\", null);\n            }\n            if (lim < 0) {\n                throw new ApiException(\"INVALID_REQUEST\", \"'limit' must be non-negative\", null);\n            }\n            limit = lim;\n        }\n\n        QuerySpec spec = new QuerySpec(tableName, filter, whereText, select, limit);\n\n        QueryResult result;\n        try {\n            result = engine.execute(spec);\n        } catch (EvalException ex) {\n            throw expressionError(ex, whereText);\n        }\n        return result.toJson();\n    }\n\n    /** 词法 -> 语法 -> 类型检查，任何阶段的错误都带位置信息。 */\n    private Expr compileExpression(String text, Table table) {\n        Expr expr;\n        try {\n            expr = Parser.parse(text);\n        } catch (LexException ex) {\n            throw expressionError(ex, text);\n        } catch (ParseException ex) {\n            throw expressionError(ex, text);\n        }\n        Schema schema = new Schema();\n        table.columns().forEach(schema::add);\n        try {\n            new TypeChecker(schema).check(expr);\n        } catch (TypeException ex) {\n            throw expressionError(ex, text);\n        }\n        return expr;\n    }\n\n    private static ApiException expressionError(ExpressionException ex, String source) {\n        Map<String, Object> detail = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        detail.put(\"message\", ex.getMessage());\n        detail.put(\"offset\", ex.getPosition());\n        if (source != null) {\n            int[] lc = ErrorFormatter.lineAndColumn(source, ex.getPosition());\n            detail.put(\"line\", lc[0]);\n            detail.put(\"column\", lc[1]);\n            detail.put(\"snippet\", ErrorFormatter.caret(source, ex.getPosition()));\n        }\n        String code = switch (ex) {\n            case LexException ignored -> \"LEX_ERROR\";\n            case ParseException ignored -> \"PARSE_ERROR\";\n            case TypeException ignored -> \"TYPE_ERROR\";\n            case EvalException ignored -> \"EVAL_ERROR\";\n            default -> \"EXPRESSION_ERROR\";\n        };\n        return new ApiException(code, ex.getMessage(), detail);\n    }\n\n    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // export\n    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    private Map<String, Object> handleExport(Map<String, Object> request) {\n        String tableName = optString(request, \"table\");\n\n        Map<String, Object> result = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        result.put(\"ok\", true);\n        result.put(\"action\", \"export\");\n\n        List<Table> targets = new ArrayList<>();\n        if (tableName != null) {\n            Table table = catalog.get(tableName);\n            if (table == null) {\n                throw new ApiException(\"UNKNOWN_TABLE\", \"unknown table '\" + tableName + \"'\", null);\n            }\n            targets.add(table);\n        } else {\n            targets.addAll(catalog.all().values());\n        }\n\n printUsage();\n                yield 2;\n            }\n        };\n        System.exit(exitCode);\n    }\n\n    private static int serve(String[] args) {\n        int port = 8080;\n        for (int i server.createContext(\"/health\", this::handleHealth);\n        server.setExecutor(null);\n        server.start();\n    }\n\n    public void stop() {\n        if (server != null) {\n         exchange.close();\n        }\n    }\n\n    private static void writeJson(HttpExchange exchange, int status, String body) throws IOException {\n        byte[] bytes = body.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);\n        exchange.getResponseHeaders().set(\"Content-Type\", \"application/json; charset=utf-8\");\n        exchange.sendResponseHeaders(status, bytes.length);\n    启动 HTTP 服务（默认端口 8080）\n *   java -cp out tvl.Main run  <file.json>           执行一个或一批 JSON 请求后退出\n *   java -cp out tvl.Main stdin                      从标准输入读取 JSON 请求\n *\n * 单文件支持三种形态：\n *   1) 单个 main(String[] args) {\n        if (args.length == 0) {\n            printUsage();\n            System.exit(2);\n        }\n        String command = args[0];\n        int exitCode = switch (command) {\n            case \"serve\" -> serve(args);\n            case \"run\" -> runFile(args);\n            case \"stdin\" -> runStdin();\n            case \"-h\", \"--help\", \"help\" -> {\n                printUsage();\n                yield 0;\n            }\n            default -> {\n                System.err.println(\"unknown command: \" + command);\n                printUsage();\n                yield 2;\n            }\n        };\n        System.exit(exitCode);\n    }\n\n    private static int serve(String[] args) {\n        int port = 8080;\n        for (int i = 1; i < args.length; i++) {\n            if (\"--port\".equals(args[i]) && i + 1 < args.length) {\n                port = Integer.parseInt(args[++i]);\n            }\n        }\n        try {\n            ApiServer server = new ApiServer(port);\n            server.start();\n            System.out.println(\"tvl query engine listening on http://localhost:\" + port);\n            System.out.println(\"POST JSON to http://localhost:\" + port + \"/query ; Ctrl+C to stop\");\n            // 阻塞直到进程被终止\n            Thread.currentThread().join();\n            return 0;\n        } catch (NumberFormatException ex) {\n            System.err.println(\"invalid port number\");\n            return 2;\n        } catch (IOException ex) {\n            System.err.println(\"failed to start server: \" + ex.getMessage());\n            return 1;\n        } catch (InterruptedException ex) {\n            Thread.currentThread().interrupt();\n            return 0;\n        }\n    }\n\n    private static int runFile(String[] args) {\n        if (args.length < 2) {\n            System.err.println(\"usage: run <file.json>\");\n            return 2;\n        }\n        Path path = Path.of(args[1]);\n        if (!Files.isReadable(path)) {\n            System.err.println(\"cannot read file: \" + path);\n            return 2;\n        }\n        String content;\n        try {\n            content = Files.readString(path, StandardCharsets.UTF_8);\n        } catch (IOException ex) {\n            System.err.println(\"failed to read file: \" + ex.getMessage());\n            return 1;\n        }\n        String output = executeInput(content);\n        System.out.println(Json.writePretty(Json.parse(output)));\n        return output.contains(\"\\\"ok\\\":false\") ? 1 : 0;\n    }\n\n    private static int runStdin() {\n        String content = new String(System.in.readAllBytes(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);\n        String output = executeInput(content);\n        System.out.println(Json.writePretty(Json.parse(output)));\n        return output.contains(\"\\\"ok\\\":false\") ? 1 : 0;\n    }\n\n    /** 支持单对象 / JSON 数组 / JSON Lines；多个请求共享同一个引擎（内存表）状态。 */\n    @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n    private static String executeInput(String content) {\n        String trimmed = content.trim();\n        if (trimmed.isEmpty()) {\n            return Json.write(errorEnvelope(\"INVALID_REQUEST\", \"empty input\"));\n        }\n\n        JsonApi api = new JsonApi();\n        if (trimmed.startsWith(\"[\")) {\n            Object parsed;\n            try {\n                parsed = Json.parse(trimmed);\n            } catch (RuntimeException ex) {\n                return Json.write(errorEnvelope(\"INVALID_JSON\", ex.getMessage()));\n            }\n            List<Object> responses = new ArrayList<>();\n            for (Object item : (List<Object>) parsed) {\n                if (!(item instanceof Map<?, ?>)) {\n                    return Json.write(errorEnvelope(\"INVALID_REQUEST\",\n                            \"batch request must contain only JSON objects\"));\n                }\n                responses.add(api.handle((Map<String, Object>) item));\n            }\n            return Json.write(responses);\n        }\n\n        if (trimmed.startsWith(\"{\")) {\n            return api.handleJson(trimmed);\n        }\n\n        // JSON Lines\n        List<Object> responses = new ArrayList<>();\n        int lineNo = 0;\n        for (String line : content.split(\"\\\\R\")) {\n            lineNo++;\n            if (line.isBlank()) continue;\n            Object parsed;\n            try {\n                parsed = Json.parse(line);\n            } catch (RuntimeException ex) {\n                return Json.write(errorEnvelope(\"INVALID_JSON\",\n                        \"line \" + lineNo + \": \" + ex.getMessage()));\n            }\n            if (!(parsed instanceof Map<?, ?>)) {\n                return Json.write(errorEnvelope(\"INVALID_REQUEST\",\n                        \"line \" + lineNo + \" is not a JSON object\"));\n            }\n            responses.add(api.handle((Map<String, Object>) parsed));\n        }\n        return Json.write(responses);\n    }\n\n    private static Map<String, Object> errorEnvelope(String code, String message) {\n        Map<String, Object> m = new {"parentUuid":"be81868a-8ed7-4024-bddc-ca829990d01a","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_n58aiuipxfvjzbvbwqfcit5l","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp11/b/test/tvl/test/TruthTablesTest.java","content":"package tvl.test;\n\nimport java.util.LinkedHashMap;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\nimport tvl.evaluator.EvalException;\nimport tvl.evaluator.Evaluator;\nimport tvl.evaluator.RowLike;\nimport tvl.expr.Expr;\nimport tvl.expr.Tri;\nimport tvl.parser.Parser;\n\n/**\n * 穷举三值逻辑真值表（AND/OR 各 3x3=9 格，NOT 3 格），\n * 并覆盖 IS NULL 真值表、短路除零与 NULL 参与比较。\n */\npublic class TruthTablesTest extends TestBase {\n\n    private final Evaluator evaluator = new Evaluator();\n\n    /** 用内存 Map 实现行，null 即 SQL NULL。 */\n    private static RowLike row(Object... kv) {\n        Map<String, Object> map = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        for (int i = 0; i < kv.length; i += 2) {\n            map.put((String) kv[i], kv[i + 1]);\n        }\n        return map::get;\n    }\n\n    private static final Boolean T = Boolean.TRUE;\n    private static final Boolean F = Boolean.FALSE;\n\n    @Override\n    public String name() {\n        return \"Exhaustive 3VL truth tables\";\n    }\n\n    @Override\n    public void run() {\n        andTruthTable();\n        orTruthTable();\n        notTruthTable();\n        isNullTruthTable();\n        shortCircuit();\n        nullComparisons();\n        literalUnknown();\n    }\n\n    private void andTruthTable() {\n        // 列 a、b 取值：TRUE / FALSE / null(UNKNOWN)\n        Boolean[] values = {T, F, null};\n        // SQL AND 参考真值表，索引顺序 TRUE, FALSE, UNKNOWN\n        Tri[][] expected = {\n                {Tri.TRUE,  Tri.FALSE,   Tri.UNKNOWN}, // a = TRUE\n                {Tri.FALSE, Tri.FALSE,   Tri.FALSE},   // a = FALSE\n                {Tri.UNKNOWN, Tri.FALSE, Tri.UNKNOWN}, // a = UNKNOWN\n        };\n        Expr expr = Parser.parse(\"a AND b\");\n        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {\n            for (int j = 0; j < 3; j++) {\n                Tri actual = evaluator.evalPredicate(expr, row(\"a\", values[i], \"b\", values[j]));\n                expectEq(expected[i][j], actual,\n                        \"AND(\" + triName(values[i]) + \",\" + triName(values[j]) + \")\");\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    private void orTruthTable() {\n        Boolean[] values = {T, F, null};\n        Tri[][] expected = {\n                {Tri.TRUE,  Tri.TRUE,  Tri.TRUE},    // a = TRUE\n                {Tri.TRUE,  Tri.FALSE, Tri.UNKNOWN}, // a = FALSE\n                {Tri.TRUE,  Tri.UNKNOWN, Tri.UNKNOWN}, // a = UNKNOWN\n        };\n        Expr expr = Parser.parse(\"a OR b\");\n        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {\n            for (int j = 0; j < 3; j++) {\n                Tri actual = evaluator.evalPredicate(expr, row(\"a\", values[i], \"b\", values[j]));\n                expectEq(expected[i][j], actual,\n                        \"OR(\" + triName(values[i]) + \",\" + triName(values[j]) + \")\");\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    private void notTruthTable() {\n        Boolean[] values = {T, F, null};\n        Tri[] expected = {Tri.FALSE, Tri.TRUE, Tri.UNKNOWN};\n        Expr expr = Parser.parse(\"NOT a\");\n        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {\n            Tri actual = evaluator.evalPredicate(expr, row(\"a\", values[i]));\n            expectEq(expected[i], actual, \"NOT(\" + triName(values[i]) + \")\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    private void isNullTruthTable() {\n        // x 取非空整数与 NULL，穷举 IS NULL / IS NOT NULL\n        Expr isNull = Parser.parse(\"x IS NULL\");\n        Expr isNotNull = Parser.parse(\"x IS NOT NULL\");\n        expectEq(Tri.TRUE, evaluator.evalPredicate(isNull, row(\"x\", null)), \"NULL IS NULL\");\n        expectEq(Tri.FALSE, evaluator.evalPredicate(isNull, row(\"x\", 5L)), \"5 IS NULL\");\n        expectEq(Tri.FALSE, evaluator.evalPredicate(isNotNull, row(\"x\", null)), \"NULL IS NOT NULL\");\n        expectEq(Tri.TRUE, evaluator.evalPredicate(isNotNull, row(\"x\", 5L)), \"5 IS NOT NULL\");\n        // IS NULL 绝不受 3VL UNKNOWN 影响\n        Expr complex = Parser.parse(\"(x = 1) IS NULL\");\n        expectEq(Tri.TRUE, evaluator.evalPredicate(complex, row(\"x\", null)), \"(NULL=1) IS NULL\");\n        expectEq(Tri.FALSE, evaluator.evalPredicate(complex, row(\"x\", 1L)), \"(1=1) IS NULL\");\n    }\n\n    private void shortCircuit() {\n        // 右操作数含除零：1 / x = 1\n        Expr and = Parser.parse(\"a AND (1 / x = 1)\");\n        Expr or = Parser.parse(\"a OR (1 / x = 1)\");\n\n        // AND 左值 FALSE -> 短路，右值（含除零）绝不求值\n        expectEq(Tri.FALSE, evaluator.evalPredicate(and, row(\"a\", F, \"x\", 0L)),\n                \"FALSE AND 1/0 -> FALSE, no error (short-circuit)\");\n        // AND 左值 TRUE -> 必须求值右值 -> 除零错误\n        expectThrowsEval(\"TRUE AND 1/0\", () ->\n                evaluator.evalPredicate(and, row(\"a\", T, \"x\", 0L)));\n        // AND 左值 UNKNOWN -> 结果取决于右值，必须求值 -> 除零错误（不短路）\n        expectThrowsEval(\"UNKNOWN AND 1/0\", () ->\n                evaluator.evalPredicate(and, row(\"a\", null, \"x\", 0L)));\n        // 但 UNKNOWN AND FALSE -> FALSE（右值正常）\n        expectEq(Tri.FALSE, evaluator.evalPredicate(and, row(\"a\", null, \"x\", 1L)),\n                \"UNKNOWN AND (1/1=1=TRUE) ... 左 UNKNOWN 右 TRUE => UNKNOWN\");\n        // 上面构造右值恒真；再验证 UNKNOWN AND TRUE => UNKNOWN\n        Expr andTrue = Parser.parse(\"a AND (x = 1)\");\n        expectEq(Tri.UNKNOWN, evaluator.evalPredicate(andTrue, row(\"a\", null, \"x\", 1L)),\n                \"UNKNOWN AND TRUE -> UNKNOWN\");\n\n        // OR 左值 TRUE -> 短路\n        expectEq(Tri.TRUE, evaluator.evalPredicate(or, row(\"a\", T, \"x\", 0L)),\n                \"TRUE OR 1/0 -> TRUE, no error (short-circuit)\");\n        // OR 左值 FALSE -> 求值右值 -> 除零\n        expectThrowsEval(\"FALSE OR 1/0\", () ->\n                evaluator.evalPredicate(or, row(\"a\", F, \"x\", 0L)));\n        // OR 左值 UNKNOWN -> 求值右值 -> 除零（不短路）\n        expectThrowsEval(\"UNKNOWN OR 1/0\", () ->\n                evaluator.evalPredicate(or, row(\"a\", null, \"x\", 0L)));\n        // UNKNOWN OR FALSE -> UNKNOWN\n        Expr orFalse = Parser.parse(\"a OR (x = 2)\");\n        expectEq(Tri.UNKNOWN, evaluator.evalPredicate(orFalse, row(\"a\", null, \"x\", 1L)),\n                \"UNKNOWN OR FALSE -> UNKNOWN\");\n        // UNKNOWN OR TRUE -> TRUE\n        expectEq(Tri.TRUE, evaluator.evalPredicate(orFalse, row(\"a\", null, \"x\", 2L)),\n                \"UNKNOWN OR TRUE -> TRUE\");\n    }\n\n    private void nullComparisons() {\n        // NULL 参与任何比较都为 UNKNOWN：穷举六个比较符 x {op} y，其中左/右为 NULL\n        String[] ops = {\"=\", \"<>\", \"<\", \"<=\", \">\", \">=\"};\n        for (String op : ops) {\n            Expr leftNull = Parser.parse(\"x \" + op + \" 1\");\n            expectEq(Tri.UNKNOWN, evaluator.evalPredicate(leftNull, row(\"x\", null)),\n                    \"NULL \" + op + \" 1 -> UNKNOWN\");\n            Expr rightNull = Parser.parse(\"1 \" + op + \" x\");\n            expectEq(Tri.UNKNOWN, evaluator.evalPredicate(rightNull, row(\"x\", null)),\n                    \"1 \" + op + \" NULL -> UNKNOWN\");\n            Expr bothNull = Parser.parse(\"x \" + op + \" y\");\n            expectEq(Tri.UNKNOWN, evaluator.evalPredicate(bothNull, row(\"x\", null, \"y\", null)),\n                    \"NULL \" + op + \" NULL -> UNKNOWN (SQL: never TRUE, not even = )\");\n        }\n        // 非空整数比较的穷举小表（-1,0,1 两两组合，六种运算符）\n        long[] nums = {-1L, 0L, 1L};\n        for (long a : nums) {\n            for (long b : nums) {\n                expectEq(Tri.fromBoolean(a == b),\n                        evaluator.evalPredicate(Parser.parse(\"a = b\"), row(\"a\", a, \"b\", b)),\n                        a + \" = \" + b);\n                expectEq(Tri.fromBoolean(a != b),\n                        evaluator.evalPredicate(Parser.parse(\"a <> b\"), row(\"a\", a, \"b\", b)),\n                        a + \" <> \" + b);\n                expectEq(Tri.fromBoolean(a < b),\n                        evaluator.evalPredicate(Parser.parse(\"a < b\"), row(\"a\", a, \"b\", b)),\n                        a + \" < \" + b);\n                expectEq(Tri.fromBoolean(a <= b),\n                        evaluator.evalPredicate(Parser.parse(\"a <= b\"), row(\"a\", a, \"b\", b)),\n                        a + \" <= \" + b);\n                expectEq(Tri.fromBoolean(a > b),\n                        evaluator.evalPredicate(Parser.parse(\"a > b\"), row(\"a\", a, \"b\", b)),\n                        a + \" > \" + b);\n                expectEq(Tri.fromBoolean(a >= b),\n                        evaluator.evalPredicate(Parser.parse(\"a >= b\"), row(\"a\", a, \"b\", b)),\n                        a + \" >= \" + b);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    private void literalUnknown() {\n        expectEq(Tri.UNKNOWN,\n                evaluator.evalPredicate(Parser.parse(\"UNKNOWN\"), row()), \"UNKNOWN literal\");\n        expectEq(Tri.FALSE,\n                evaluator.evalPredicate(Parser.parse(\"NOT UNKNOWN\"), row()), \"NOT UNKNOWN\");\n        expectEq(Tri.UNKNOWN,\n                evaluator.evalPredicate(Parser.parse(\"UNKNOWN AND TRUE\"), row()),\n                \"UNKNOWN AND TRUE\");\n        expectEq(Tri.FALSE,\n                evaluator.evalPredicate(Parser.parse(\"UNKNOWN AND FALSE\"), row()),\n                \"UNKNOWN AND FALSE\");\n    }\n\n    private void expectThrowsEval(String label, Runnable r) {\n        try {\n            r.run();\n            fail(label + \" — expected EvalException but none thrown\");\n        } catch (EvalException expected) {\n            check(true, label);\n        } catch (RuntimeException other) {\n            fail(label + \" — expected EvalException but got \" + other.getClass().getSimpleName()\n                    + \": \" + other.getMessage());\n        }\n    }\n\n    private static String triName(Boolean b) {\n        return b == null ? \"UNKNOWN\" : (b ? \"TRUE\" : \"FALSE\");\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_beb717de7c432b0d21d38724","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":1144,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":66360,"output_tokens":3258,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_n58aiuipxfvjzbvbwqfcit5l":{"content":"package void run() {\n        andTruthTable();\n        orTruthTable();\n        notTruthTable();\n        isNullTruthTable();\n        shortCircuit();\n        nullComparisons();\n        literalUnknown();\n Tri[][] expected = {\n                {Tri.TRUE,  Tri.FALSE,   Tri.UNKNOWN}, // a = TRUE\n                {Tri.FALSE, Tri.FALSE,   Tri.FALSE},   // a = FALSE\n                {Tri.UNKNOWN, Tri.FALSE, Tri.UNKNOWN}, // a = UNKNOWN\n        };\n        Expr expr = Parser.parse(\"a AND b\");\n        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {\n            for (int j = 0; j < 3; j++) {\n                Tri actual = evaluator.evalPredicate(expr, row(\"a\", values[i], \"b\", values[j]));\n                expectEq(expected[i][j], actual,\n                        \"AND(\" + triName(values[i]) + \",\" + triName(values[j]) + \")\");\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    private void orTruthTable() {\n        Boolean[] values = {T, F, null};\n        Tri[][] expected = {\n                {Tri.TRUE,  Tri.TRUE,  Tri.TRUE},    // a = TRUE\n                {Tri.TRUE,  Tri.FALSE, Tri.UNKNOWN}, // a = FALSE\n                {Tri.TRUE,  Tri.UNKNOWN, Tri.UNKNOWN}, // a = UNKNOWN\n        };\n        Expr expr = Parser.parse(\"a OR b\");\n        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {\n            for (int j = 0; j < 3; j++) {\n                Tri actual = evaluator.evalPredicate(expr, row(\"a\", values[i], \"b\", values[j]));\n                expectEq(expected[i][j], actual,\n                        \"OR(\" + triName(values[i]) + \",\" + triName(values[j]) + \")\");\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    private void notTruthTable() {\n        Boolean[] values = {T, F, null};\n        Tri[] expected = {Tri.FALSE, Tri.TRUE, Tri.UNKNOWN};\n        Expr expr = Parser.parse(\"NOT a\");\n        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {\n            Tri actual = evaluator.evalPredicate(expr, row(\"a\", values[i]));\n            expectEq(expected[i], actual, \"NOT(\" + triName(values[i]) + \")\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    private void isNullTruthTable() {\n        // x 取非空整数与 NULL，穷举 IS NULL / IS NOT NULL\n        Expr isNull = Parser.parse(\"x IS NULL\");\n        Expr isNotNull = Parser.parse(\"x IS NOT NULL\");\n        expectEq(Tri.TRUE, evaluator.evalPredicate(isNull, row(\"x\", null)), \"NULL IS NULL\");\n        expectEq(Tri.FALSE, evaluator.evalPredicate(isNull, row(\"x\", 5L)), \"5 IS NULL\");\n        expectEq(Tri.FALSE, evaluator.evalPredicate(isNotNull, row(\"x\", null)), \"NULL IS NOT NULL\");\n        expectEq(Tri.TRUE, evaluator.evalPredicate(isNotNull, row(\"x\", 5L)), \"5 IS NOT NULL\");\n        // IS NULL 绝不受 3VL UNKNOWN 影响\n        Expr complex = Parser.parse(\"(x = 1) IS NULL\");\n        expectEq(Tri.TRUE, evaluator.evalPredicate(complex, row(\"x\", null)), \"(NULL=1) IS NULL\");\n        expectEq(Tri.FALSE, evaluator.evalPredicate(complex, row(\"x\", 1L)), \"(1=1) IS NULL\");\n    }\n\n    private void shortCircuit() {\n        // 右操作数含除零：1 / x = 1\n        Expr and = Parser.parse(\"a AND (1 / x = 1)\");\n        Expr or = Parser.parse(\"a OR (1 / x = 1)\");\n\n        // AND 左值 FALSE -> 短路，右值（含除零）绝不求值\n        expectEq(Tri.FALSE, evaluator.evalPredicate(and, row(\"a\", null, \"x\", 1L)),\n                \"UNKNOWN AND (1/1=1=TRUE) ... 左 UNKNOWN 右 TRUE => UNKNOWN\");\n        // 上面构造右值恒真；再验证 UNKNOWN AND TRUE => UNKNOWN\n OR (x = 2)\");\n        expectEq(Tri.UNKNOWN, evaluator.evalPredicate(orFalse, row(\"a\", null, \"x\", 1L)),\n                \"UNKNOWN OR FALSE -> UNKNOWN\");\n        // UNKNOWN OR TRUE -> TRUE\n tvl.test;\n\nimport java.util.LinkedHashMap;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\nimport tvl.evaluator.EvalException;\nimport tvl.evaluator.Evaluator;\nimport tvl.evaluator.RowLike;\nimport tvl.expr.Expr;\nimport tvl.expr.Tri;\nimport tvl.parser.Parser;\n\n/**\n * 穷举三值逻辑真值表（AND/OR 各 3x3=9 格，NOT 3 格），\n * 并覆盖 IS NULL 真值表、短路除零与 NULL 参与比较。\n */\npublic class TruthTablesTest extends TestBase {\n\n    private final Evaluator evaluator = new Evaluator();\n\n    /** 用内存 Map 实现行，null 即 SQL NULL。 */\n    private static RowLike row(Object... kv) {\n        Map<String, Object> map = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        for (int i = 0; i < kv.length; i += 2) {\n            map.put((String) kv[i], kv[i + 1]);\n        }\n        return map::get;\n    }\n\n    private static final Boolean T = Boolean.TRUE;\n    private static final Boolean F = Boolean.FALSE;\n\n    @Override\n    public String name() {\n        return \"Exhaustive 3VL truth tables\";\n    }\n\n    @Override\n    public void run() {\n        andTruthTable();\n        orTruthTable();\n        notTruthTable();\n        isNullTruthTable();\n        shortCircuit();\n        nullComparisons();\n        literalUnknown();\n    }\n\n    private void andTruthTable() {\n        // 列 a、b 取值：TRUE / FALSE / null(UNKNOWN)\n        Boolean[] values = {T, F, null};\n        // SQL AND 参考真值表，索引顺序 TRUE, FALSE, UNKNOWN\n        Tri[][] expected = {\n                {Tri.TRUE,  Tri.FALSE,   Tri.UNKNOWN}, // a = TRUE\n                {Tri.FALSE, Tri.FALSE,   Tri.FALSE},   // a = FALSE\n                {Tri.UNKNOWN, Tri.FALSE, Tri.UNKNOWN}, // a = UNKNOWN\n        };\n        Expr expr = Parser.parse(\"a AND b\");\n        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {\n            for (int j = 0; j < 3; j++) {\n                Tri actual = evaluator.evalPredicate(expr, row(\"a\", values[i], \"b\", values[j]));\n                expectEq(expected[i][j], actual,\n                        \"AND(\" + triName(values[i]) + \",\" + triName(values[j]) + \")\");\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    private void orTruthTable() {\n        Boolean[] values = {T, F, null};\n        Tri[][] expected = {\n                {Tri.TRUE,  Tri.TRUE,  Tri.TRUE},    // a = TRUE\n                {Tri.TRUE,  Tri.FALSE, Tri.UNKNOWN}, // a = FALSE\n                {Tri.TRUE,  Tri.UNKNOWN, Tri.UNKNOWN}, // a = UNKNOWN\n        };\n        Expr expr = Parser.parse(\"a OR b\");\n        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {\n            for (int j = 0; j < 3; j++) {\n                Tri actual = evaluator.evalPredicate(expr, row(\"a\", values[i], \"b\", values[j]));\n                expectEq(expected[i][j], actual,\n                        \"OR(\" + triName(values[i]) + \",\" + triName(values[j]) + \")\");\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    private void notTruthTable() {\n        Boolean[] values = {T, F, null};\n        Tri[] expected = {Tri.FALSE, Tri.TRUE, Tri.UNKNOWN};\n        Expr expr = Parser.parse(\"NOT a\");\n        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {\n            Tri actual = evaluator.evalPredicate(expr, row(\"a\", values[i]));\n            expectEq(expected[i], actual, \"NOT(\" + triName(values[i]) + \")\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    private void isNullTruthTable() {\n        // x 取非空整数与 NULL，穷举 IS NULL / IS NOT NULL\n        Expr isNull = Parser.parse(\"x IS NULL\");\n        Expr isNotNull = Parser.parse(\"x IS NOT NULL\");\n        expectEq(Tri.TRUE, evaluator.evalPredicate(isNull, row(\"x\", null)), \"NULL IS NULL\");\n        expectEq(Tri.FALSE, evaluator.evalPredicate(isNull, row(\"x\", 5L)), \"5 IS NULL\");\n        expectEq(Tri.FALSE, evaluator.evalPredicate(isNotNull, row(\"x\", null)), \"NULL IS NOT NULL\");\n        expectEq(Tri.TRUE, evaluator.evalPredicate(isNotNull, row(\"x\", 5L)), \"5 IS NOT NULL\");\n        // IS NULL 绝不受 3VL UNKNOWN 影响\n        Expr complex = Parser.parse(\"(x = 1) IS NULL\");\n        expectEq(Tri.TRUE, evaluator.evalPredicate(complex, row(\"x\", null)), \"(NULL=1) IS NULL\");\n        expectEq(Tri.FALSE, evaluator.evalPredicate(complex, row(\"x\", 1L)), \"(1=1) IS NULL\");\n    }\n\n    private void shortCircuit() {\n        // 右操作数含除零：1 / x = 1\n        Expr and = Parser.parse(\"a AND (1 / x = 1)\");\n        Expr or = Parser.parse(\"a OR (1 / x = 1)\");\n\n        // AND 左值 FALSE -> 短路，右值（含除零）绝不求值\n        expectEq(Tri.FALSE, evaluator.evalPredicate(and, row(\"a\", F, \"x\", 0L)),\n                \"FALSE AND 1/0 -> FALSE, no error (short-circuit)\");\n        // AND 左值 TRUE -> 必须求值右值 -> 除零错误\n        expectThrowsEval(\"TRUE AND 1/0\", () ->\n                evaluator.evalPredicate(and, row(\"a\", T, \"x\", 0L)));\n        // AND 左值 UNKNOWN -> 结果取决于右值，必须求值 -> 除零错误（不短路）\n        expectThrowsEval(\"UNKNOWN AND 1/0\", () ->\n                evaluator.evalPredicate(and, row(\"a\", null, \"x\", 0L)));\n        // 但 UNKNOWN AND FALSE -> FALSE（右值正常）\n        expectEq(Tri.FALSE, evaluator.evalPredicate(and, row(\"a\", null, \"x\", 1L)),\n                \"UNKNOWN AND (1/1=1=TRUE) ... 左 UNKNOWN 右 TRUE => UNKNOWN\");\n        // 上面构造右值恒真；再验证 UNKNOWN AND TRUE => UNKNOWN\n        Expr andTrue = Parser.parse(\"a AND (x = 1)\");\n        expectEq(Tri.UNKNOWN, evaluator.evalPredicate(andTrue, row(\"a\", null, \"x\", 1L)),\n                \"UNKNOWN AND TRUE -> UNKNOWN\");\n\n        // OR 左值 TRUE -> 短路\n        expectEq(Tri.TRUE, evaluator.evalPredicate(or, row(\"a\", T, \"x\", 0L)),\n                \"TRUE OR 1/0 -> TRUE, no error (short-circuit)\");\n        // OR 左值 FALSE -> 求值右值 -> 除零\n        expectThrowsEval(\"FALSE OR 1/0\", () ->\n                evaluator.evalPredicate(or, row(\"a\", F, \"x\", 0L)));\n        // OR 左值 UNKNOWN -> 求值右值 -> 除零（不短路）\n        expectThrowsEval(\"UNKNOWN OR 1/0\", () ->\n                evaluator.evalPredicate(or, row(\"a\", null, \"x\", 0L)));\n        // UNKNOWN OR FALSE -> UNKNOWN\n        Expr orFalse = Parser.parse(\"a OR (x = 2)\");\n        expectEq(Tri.UNKNOWN, evaluator.evalPredicate(orFalse, row(\"a\", null, \"x\", 1L)),\n                \"UNKNOWN OR FALSE -> UNKNOWN\");\n        // UNKNOWN OR TRUE -> TRUE\n        expectEq(Tri.TRUE, evaluator.evalPredicate(orFalse, row(\"a\", null, \"x\", 2L)),\n                \"UNKNOWN OR TRUE -> TRUE\");\n    }\n\n    private void nullComparisons() {\n        // NULL 参与任何比较都为 UNKNOWN：穷举六个比较符 x {op} y，其中左/右为 NULL\n        String[] ops = {\"=\", \"<>\", \"<\", \"<=\", \">\", \">=\"};\n        for (String op : ops) {\n            Expr leftNull = Parser.parse(\"x \" + op + \" 1\");\n            expectEq(Tri.UNKNOWN, evaluator.evalPredicate(leftNull, row(\"x\", null)),\n                    \"NULL \" + op + \" 1 -> UNKNOWN\");\n            Expr rightNull = Parser.parse(\"1 \" + op + \" x\");\n            expectEq(Tri.UNKNOWN, evaluator.evalPredicate(rightNull, row(\"x\", null)),\n                    \"1 \" + op + \" NULL -> UNKNOWN\");\n            Expr bothNull = Parser.parse(\"x \" + op + \" y\");\n            expectEq(Tri.UNKNOWN, evaluator.evalPredicate(bothNull, row(\"x\", null, \"y\", null)),\n                    \"NULL \" + op + \" NULL -> UNKNOWN (SQL: never TRUE, not even = )\");\n        }\n        // 非空整数比较的穷举小表（-1,0,1 两两组合，六种运算符）\n        long[] nums = {-1L, 0L, 1L};\n        for (long a : nums) {\n            for (long b : nums) {\n                expectEq(Tri.fromBoolean(a == b),\n                        evaluator.evalPredicate(Parser.parse(\"a = b\"), row(\"a\", a, \"b\", b)),\n                        a + \" = \" + b);\n                expectEq(Tri.fromBoolean(a != b),\n                        evaluator.evalPredicate(Parser.parse(\"a <> b\"), row(\"a\", a, \"b\", b)),\n                        a + \" <> \" + b);\n                expectEq(Tri.fromBoolean(a < b),\n                        evaluator.evalPredicate(Parser.parse(\"a < b\"), row(\"a\", a, \"b\", b)),\n                        a + \" < \" + b);\n                expectEq(Tri.fromBoolean(a <= b),\n                        evaluator.evalPredicate(Parser.parse(\"a <= b\"), row(\"a\", a, \"b\", b)),\n                        a + \" <= \" + b);\n                expectEq(Tri.fromBoolean(a > b),\n                        evaluator.evalPredicate(Parser.parse(\"a > b\"), row(\"a\", a, \"b\", b)),\n                        a + \" > \" + b);\n                expectEq(Tri.fromBoolean(a >= b),\n                        evaluator.evalPredicate(Parser.parse(\"a >= b\"), row(\"a\", a, \"b\", b)),\n                        a + \" >= \" + b);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    private void literalUnknown() {\n        expectEq(Tri.UNKNOWN,\n                evaluator.evalPredicate(Parser.parse(\"UNKNOWN\"), row()), \"UNKNOWN literal\");\n        expectEq(Tri.FALSE,\n                evaluator.evalPredicate(Parser.parse(\"NOT UNKNOWN\"), row()), \"NOT UNKNOWN\");\n        expectEq(Tri.UNKNOWN,\n                evaluator.evalPredicate(Parser.parse(\"UNKNOWN AND TRUE\"), row()),\n                \"UNKNOWN AND TRUE\");\n        expectEq(Tri.FALSE,\n                evaluator.evalPredicate(Parser.parse(\"UNKNOWN AND FALSE\"), row()),\n                \"UNKNOWN AND FALSE\");\n    }\n\n    private void expectThrowsEval(String label, Runnable r) {\n        try {\n            r.run();\n            fail(label + \" — expected EvalException but none thrown\");\n        } catch (EvalException expected) {\n            check(true, label);\n        } catch (RuntimeException other) {\n            fail(label + \" — expected EvalException but got \" + other.getClass().getSimpleName()\n                    + \": \" + other.getMessage());\n        }\n    }\n\n    private static String triName(Boolean b) {\n        return b == null ? \"UNKNOWN\" : (b ? \"TRUE\" : \"FALSE\");\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"eaedfae6-19f7-4b03-a7b2-370d9ac531fd","session_id":"0bae1d86-80df-45f1-8b2f-c35225e023c1","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp11/b","sessionId":"0bae1d86-80df-45f1-8b2f-c35225e023c1","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp11-b","slug":"starry-churning-cookie"}

tvl.evaluator.EvalException;\nimport tvl.evaluator.Evaluator;\nimport tvl.evaluator.RowLike;\nimport tvl.expr.Expr;\nimport tvl.expr.Tri;\nimport tvl.parser.Parser;\n\n/**\n * 穷举三值逻辑真值表（AND/OR 各 3x3=9 格，NOT 3 格），\n * 并覆盖 IS NULL 真值表、短路除零与 NULL 参与比较。\n */\npublic class TruthTablesTest extends TestBase {\n\n    private final Evaluator evaluator = new Evaluator();\n\n    /** 用内存 Map 实现行，null 即 SQL NULL。 */\n    private static RowLike row(Object... kv) {\n        Map<String, Object> map = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        for (int i = 0; i < kv.length; i += 2) {\n            map.put((String) kv[i], kv[i + 1]);\n        }\n        return map::get;\n    }\n\n    private static final Boolean T = Boolean.TRUE;\n    private static final Boolean F = Boolean.FALSE;\n\n    @Override\n    public String name() {\n        return \"Exhaustive 3VL truth tables\";\n    }\n\n    @Override\n    public void run() {\n        andTruthTable();\n        orTruthTable();\n        notTruthTable();\n        isNullTruthTable();\n        shortCircuit();\n        nullComparisons();\n        literalUnknown();\n    }\n\n    private void andTruthTable() {\n        // 列 a、b 取值：TRUE / FALSE / null(UNKNOWN)\n        Boolean[] values = {T, F, null};\n        // SQL AND 参考真值表，索引顺序 TRUE, FALSE, UNKNOWN\n        Tri[][] expected = {\n                {Tri.TRUE,  Tri.FALSE,   Tri.UNKNOWN}, // a = TRUE\n                {Tri.FALSE, Tri.FALSE,   Tri.FALSE},   // a = FALSE\n                {Tri.UNKNOWN, Tri.FALSE, Tri.UNKNOWN}, // a = UNKNOWN\n        };\n        Expr expr = Parser.parse(\"a AND b\");\n        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {\n            for (int j = 0; j < 3; j++) {\n                Tri actual = evaluator.evalPredicate(expr, row(\"a\", values[i], \"b\", values[j]));\n                expectEq(expected[i][j], actual,\n                        \"AND(\" + triName(values[i]) + \",\" + triName(values[j]) + \")\");\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    private void orTruthTable() {\n        Boolean[] values = {T, F, null};\n        Tri[][] expected = {\n                {Tri.TRUE,  Tri.TRUE,  Tri.TRUE},    // a = TRUE\n                {Tri.TRUE,  Tri.FALSE, Tri.UNKNOWN}, // a = FALSE\n                {Tri.TRUE,  Tri.UNKNOWN, Tri.UNKNOWN}, // a = UNKNOWN\n        };\n        Expr expr = Parser.parse(\"a OR b\");\n        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {\n            for (int j = 0; j < 3; j++) {\n                Tri actual = evaluator.evalPredicate(expr, row(\"a\", values[i], \"b\", values[j]));\n                expectEq(expected[i][j], actual,\n                        \"OR(\" + triName(values[i]) + \",\" + triName(values[j]) + \")\");\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    private void notTruthTable() {\n        Boolean[] values = {T, F, null};\n        Tri[] expected = {Tri.FALSE, Tri.TRUE, Tri.UNKNOWN};\n        Expr expr = Parser.parse(\"NOT a\");\n        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {\n            Tri actual = evaluator.evalPredicate(expr, row(\"a\", values[i]));\n            expectEq(expected[i], actual, \"NOT(\" + triName(values[i]) + \")\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    private void isNullTruthTable() {\n        // x 取非空整数与 NULL，穷举 IS NULL / IS NOT NULL\n        Expr isNull = Parser.parse(\"x IS NULL\");\n        Expr isNotNull = Parser.parse(\"x IS NOT NULL\");\n        expectEq(Tri.TRUE, evaluator.evalPredicate(isNull, row(\"x\", null)), \"NULL IS NULL\");\n        expectEq(Tri.FALSE, evaluator.evalPredicate(isNull, row(\"x\", 5L)), \"5 IS NULL\");\n        expectEq(Tri.FALSE, evaluator.evalPredicate(isNotNull, row(\"x\", null)), \"NULL IS NOT NULL\");\n        expectEq(Tri.TRUE, evaluator.evalPredicate(isNotNull, row(\"x\", 5L)), \"5 IS NOT NULL\");\n        // IS NULL 绝不受 3VL UNKNOWN 影响\n        Expr complex = Parser.parse(\"(x = 1) IS NULL\");\n        expectEq(Tri.TRUE, evaluator.evalPredicate(complex, row(\"x\", null)), \"(NULL=1) IS NULL\");\n        expectEq(Tri.FALSE, evaluator.evalPredicate(complex, row(\"x\", 1L)), \"(1=1) IS NULL\");\n    }\n\n    private void shortCircuit() {\n        // 右操作数含除零：1 / x = 1\n        Expr and = Parser.parse(\"a AND (1 / x = 1)\");\n        Expr or = Parser.parse(\"a OR (1 / x = 1)\");\n\n        // AND 左值 FALSE -> 短路，右值（含除零）绝不求值\n        expectEq(Tri.FALSE, evaluator.evalPredicate(and, row(\"a\", F, \"x\", 0L)),\n                \"FALSE AND 1/0 -> FALSE, no error (short-circuit)\");\n        // AND 左值 TRUE -> 必须求值右值 -> 除零错误\n        expectThrowsEval(\"TRUE AND 1/0\", () ->\n                evaluator.evalPredicate(and, row(\"a\", T, \"x\", 0L)));\n        // AND 左值 UNKNOWN -> 结果取决于右值，必须求值 -> 除零错误（不短路）\n        expectThrowsEval(\"UNKNOWN AND 1/0\", () ->\n                evaluator.evalPredicate(and, row(\"a\", null, \"x\", 0L)));\n        // 但 UNKNOWN AND FALSE -> FALSE（右值正常）\n        expectEq(Tri.FALSE, evaluator.evalPredicate(and, row(\"a\", null, \"x\", 1L)),\n                \"UNKNOWN AND (1/1=1=TRUE) ... 左 UNKNOWN 右 TRUE => UNKNOWN\");\n        // 上面构造右值恒真；再验证 UNKNOWN AND TRUE => UNKNOWN\n        Expr andTrue = Parser.parse(\"a AND (x = 1)\");\n        expectEq(Tri.UNKNOWN, evaluator.evalPredicate(andTrue, row(\"a\", null, \"x\", 1L)),\n                \"UNKNOWN AND TRUE -> UNKNOWN\");\n\n        // OR 左值 TRUE -> 短路\n        expectEq(Tri.TRUE, evaluator.evalPredicate(or, row(\"a\", T, \"x\", 0L)),\n                \"TRUE OR 1/0 -> TRUE, no error (short-circuit)\");\n        // OR 左值 FALSE -> 求值右值 -> 除零\n        expectThrowsEval(\"FALSE OR 1/0\", () ->\n                evaluator.evalPredicate(or, row(\"a\", F, \"x\", 0L)));\n        // OR 左值 UNKNOWN -> 求值右值 -> 除零（不短路）\n        expectThrowsEval(\"UNKNOWN OR 1/0\", () ->\n                evaluator.evalPredicate(or, row(\"a\", null, \"x\", 0L)));\n        // UNKNOWN OR FALSE -> UNKNOWN\n        Expr orFalse = Parser.parse(\"a OR (x = 2)\");\n        expectEq(Tri.UNKNOWN, evaluator.evalPredicate(orFalse, row(\"a\", null, \"x\", 1L)),\n                \"UNKNOWN OR FALSE -> UNKNOWN\");\n        // UNKNOWN OR TRUE -> TRUE\n        expectEq(Tri.TRUE, evaluator.evalPredicate(orFalse, row(\"a\", null, \"x\", 2L)),\n                \"UNKNOWN OR TRUE -> TRUE\");\n    }\n\n    private void nullComparisons() {\n        // NULL 参与任何比较都为 UNKNOWN：穷举六个比较符 x {op} y，其中左/右为 NULL\n        String[] ops = {\"=\", \"<>\", \"<\", \"<=\", \">\", \">=\"};\n        for (String op : ops) {\n            Expr leftNull = Parser.parse(\"x \" + op + \" 1\");\n            expectEq(Tri.UNKNOWN, evaluator.evalPredicate(leftNull, row(\"x\", null)),\n                    \"NULL \" + op + \" 1 -> UNKNOWN\");\n            Expr rightNull = Parser.parse(\"1 \" + op + \" x\");\n            expectEq(Tri.UNKNOWN, evaluator.evalPredicate(rightNull, row(\"x\", null)),\n                    \"1 \" + op + \" NULL -> UNKNOWN\");\n            Expr bothNull = Parser.parse(\"x \" + op + \" y\");\n            expectEq(Tri.UNKNOWN, evaluator.evalPredicate(bothNull, row(\"x\", null, \"y\", null)),\n                    \"NULL \" + op + \" NULL -> UNKNOWN (SQL: never TRUE, not even = )\");\n        }\n        // 非空整数比较的穷举小表（-1,0,1 两两组合，六种运算符）\n        long[] nums = {-1L, 0L, 1L};\n        for (long a : nums) {\n            for (long b : nums) {\n                expectEq(Tri.fromBoolean(a == b),\n                        evaluator.evalPredicate(Parser.parse(\"a = b\"), row(\"a\", a, \"b\", b)),\n                        a + \" = \" + b);\n                expectEq(Tri.fromBoolean(a != b),\n                        evaluator.evalPredicate(Parser.parse(\"a <> b\"), row(\"a\", a, \"b\", b)),\n                        a + \" <> \" + b);\n                expectEq(Tri.fromBoolean(a < b),\n                        evaluator.evalPredicate(Parser.parse(\"a < b\"), row(\"a\", a, \"b\", b)),\n                        a + \" < \" + b);\n                expectEq(Tri.fromBoolean(a <= b),\n                        evaluator.evalPredicate(Parser.parse(\"a <= b\"), row(\"a\", a, \"b\", b)),\n                        a + \" <= \" + b);\n                expectEq(Tri.fromBoolean(a > b),\n                        evaluator.evalPredicate(Parser.parse(\"a > b\"), row(\"a\", a, \"b\", b)),\n                        a + \" > \" + b);\n                expectEq(Tri.fromBoolean(a >= b),\n                        evaluator.evalPredicate(Parser.parse(\"a >= b\"), row(\"a\", a, \"b\", b)),\n                        a + \" >= \" + b);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    private void literalUnknown() {\n        expectEq(Tri.UNKNOWN,\n                evaluator.evalPredicate(Parser.parse(\"UNKNOWN\"), row()), \"UNKNOWN literal\");\n        expectEq(Tri.FALSE,\n                evaluator.evalPredicate(Parser.parse(\"NOT UNKNOWN\"), row()), \"NOT UNKNOWN\");\n        expectEq(Tri.UNKNOWN,\n                evaluator.evalPredicate(Parser.parse(\"UNKNOWN AND TRUE\"), row()),\n                \"UNKNOWN AND TRUE\");\n        expectEq(Tri.FALSE,\n                evaluator.evalPredicate(Parser.parse(\"UNKNOWN AND FALSE\"), row()),\n                \"UNKNOWN AND FALSE\");\n    }\n\n    private void expectThrowsEval(String label, Runnable r) {\n        try {\n            r.run();\n            fail(label + \" — expected EvalException but none thrown\");\n        } catch (EvalException expected) {\n            check(true, label);\n        } catch (RuntimeException other) {\n            fail(label + \" — expected EvalException but got \" + other.getClass().getSimpleName()\n                    + \": \" + other.getMessage());\n        }\n    }\n\n    private static String triName(Boolean b) {\n        return b == null ? \"UNKNOWN\" : (b ? \"TRUE\" : \"FALSE\");\n tvl.test;\n\nimport tvl.expr.Expr;\nimport tvl.parser.ParseException;\nimport tvl.parser.Parser;\n\n/**\n * 运算符优先级与结合性测试：把 AST 渲染成 S-表达式进行结构断言。\n */\npublic class ParserPrecedenceTest extends TestBase {\n\n    @Override\n    public String name() {\n        return \"Parser precedence / grammar\";\n    }\n\n    @Override\n    public void run() {\n        // OR 低于 AND\n        expectEq(\"(OR a (AND b c))\", sexpr(\"a OR b AND c\"), \"OR < AND\");\n        // AND 低于 NOT\n        expectEq(\"(AND (NOT a) b)\", sexpr(\"NOT a AND b\"), \"NOT > AND\");\n        // 比较低于算术\n        expectEq(\"(= (+ a b) (* c d))\", sexpr(\"a + b = c * d\"), \"arith below comparison\");\n        // 乘除高于加减，同级左结合\n        expectEq(\"(- (+ a (* b c)) d)\", sexpr(\"a + b * c - d\"), \"* over +, left-assoc\");\n        expectEq(\"(/ (* a b) c)\", sexpr(\"a * b / c\"), \"*/ left-assoc\");\n        expectEq(\"(+ a (- b))\", sexpr(\"a + -b\"), \"unary minus\");\n        expectEq(\"(- (- a))\", sexpr(\"--a\"), \"double unary minus\");\n        // NOT 作用于比较谓词整体\n        expectEq(\"(NOT (= a b))\", sexpr(\"NOT a = b\"), \"NOT binds the comparison\");\n        expectEq(\"(NOT (= a b))\", sexpr(\"NOT (a = b)\"), \"NOT (a=b)\");\n        // 括号改变结构\n        expectEq(\"(AND (OR a b) c)\", sexpr(\"(a OR b) AND c\"), \"parentheses override\");\n        // IS NULL 作用于整体算术/比较优先级层\n        expectEq(\"(ISNULL (+ a b) false)\", sexpr(\"a + b IS NULL\"), \"IS NULL on additive\");\n        expectEq(\"(ISNULL a true)\", sexpr(\"a IS NOT NULL\"), \"IS NOT NULL\");\n        expectEq(\"(ISNULL (= a b) false)\", sexpr(\"(a = b) IS NULL\"), \"IS NULL over comparison\");\n        // 关键字大小写不敏感，列名大小写敏感\n        expectEq(\"(AND Aa bB)\", sexpr(\"Aa aNd bB\"), \"keywords case-insensitive\");\n        // 比较符别名\n        expectEq(\"(<> a b)\", sexpr(\"a != b\"), \"!= maps to <>\");\n        expectEq(\"(= a b)\", sexpr(\"a == b\"), \"== maps to =\");\n        // 链式比较不允许\n        expectParseError(\"a < b < c\", \"chained comparison\");\n        // 未闭合括号 / 悬空运算符\n        expectParseError(\"(a AND b\", \"unclosed paren\");\n        expectParseError(\"a AND\", \"trailing AND\");\n        expectParseError(\"a + )\", \"unexpected )\");\n        expectParseError(\"* 3\", \"leading *\");\n        // IS 后面必须跟 NULL\n        expectParseError(\"a IS b\", \"IS without NULL\");\n        // 空表达式\n        expectParseError(\"\", \"empty expression\");\n        expectParseError(\"   \", \"whitespace only\");\n    }\n\n    private String sexpr(String source) {\n        return render(Parser.parse(source));\n    }\n\n    private void expectParseError(String source, String label) {\n        try {\n            Parser.parse(source);\n            fail(label + \" — expected ParseException for <\" + source + \">\");\n        } catch (ParseException ex) {\n            check(true, label + \" (\" + ex.getMessage() + \")\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    /** 渲染 AST 为规范 S-表达式。 */\n    static String render(Expr e) {\n        return switch (e) {\n            case Expr.Literal lit -> switch (lit.kind) {\n                case INTEGER -> String.valueOf(lit.value);\n                case STRING -> \"'\" + lit.value + \"'\";\n                case BOOLEAN -> String.valueOf(lit.value).toUpperCase();\n                case NULL -> \"NULL\";\n                case UNKNOWN -> \"UNKNOWN\";\n            };\n            case Expr.Column c -> c.name;\n            case Expr.UnaryMinus um -> \"(- \" + render(um.operand) + \")\";\n            case Expr.BinaryArith b -> \"(\" + shortOp(b.op) + \" \"\n                    + render(b.left) + \" \" + render(b.right) + \")\";\n            case Expr.Compare c -> \"(\" + c.op.symbol + \" \" + render(c.left) + \" \"\n                    + render(c.right) + \")\";\n            case Expr.IsNull isn -> \"(ISNULL \" + render(isn.operand) + \" \"\n                    + isn.negated + \")\";\n            case Expr.Not n -> \"(NOT \" + render(n.operand) + \")\";\n            case Expr.Logical l -> \"(\" + l.op.name() + \" \" + render(l.left) + \" \"\n                    + render(l.right) + \")\";\n        };\n    }\n\n    private static String shortOp(Expr.ArithOp op) {\n        return switch (op) {\n            case ADD -> \"+\";\n            case SUB -> \"-\";\n            case MUL -> \"*\";\n            case DIV -> \"/\";\n        };\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_20c6342adb8a839cb983326f","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":711,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":70456,"output_tokens":1387,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_3bm8vbil9lklp3isafn1x3pw":{"content":"package tvl.test;\n\nimport tvl.analyzer.DataType;\nimport tvl.analyzer.Schema;\nimport tvl.analyzer.TypeChecker;\nimport tvl.analyzer.TypeException;\nimport tvl.api.ErrorFormatter;\nimport tvl.evaluator.EvalException;\nimport tvl.evaluator.Evaluator;\nimport tvl.evaluator.RowLike;\nimport tvl.expr.ExpressionException;\nimport tvl.lexer.LexException;\nimport tvl.parser.ParseException;\nimport tvl.parser.Parser;\n\nimport java.util.LinkedHashMap;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\n/** 验证词法/语法/类型/运行期错误都精确定位到字符偏移与行列。 */\npublic class ErrorPositionTest extends TestBase {\n\n    private static RowLike row(Object... kv) {\n        Map<String, Object> map = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        for (int i = 0; i < kv.length; i += 2) {\n            map.put((String) kv[i], kv[i + 1]);\n        }\n        return map::get;\n    }\n\n    @Override\n    public String name() {\n        return \"Error positions (offset/line/column)\";\n    }\n\n    @Override\n    public void run() {\n        // 词法错误：非法字符 @ 位于偏移 4（\"a OR\" 后是空格偏移3，@ 在4）\n        expectOffset(LexException.class, \"a OR @b\", 4, \"illegal char\");\n        // 未闭合字符串\n        expectOffset(LexException.class, \"'abc\", 0, \"unterminated string\");\n        // 整数字面量溢出\n        expectOffset(LexException.class, \"99999999999999999999999\", 0, \"integer overflow lex\");\n\n        // 语法错误：未知标记的位置\n        expectOffset(ParseException.class, \"a AND )\", 6, \"unexpected token\");\n        expectOffset(ParseException.class, \"a +\", 3, \"dangling operator\");\n        expectOffset(ParseException.class, \"(a\", 2, \"missing close paren at EOF\");\n        expectOffset(ParseException.class, \"a < 1 < 2\", 5, \"chained comparison at second <\");\n\n        // 类型错误：未知列指向列名起点\n        expectTypeError(\"unknown_col = 1\", 0, \"unknown column points at its name\");\n        // \"a AND 1\"：AND 右侧必须布尔，整数 1 的位置是 6\n        expectTypeError(\"a AND 1\", 6, \"non-boolean operand points at '1'\");\n        // 算术遇字符串：b + 'x' 中 'x' 偏移 4\n        expectTypeError(\"b + 'x'\", 4, \"string in arithmetic points at string literal\");\n        // 比较两侧类型不兼容：整数 = 字符串，错误指向 '=' 偏移 2\n        expectTypeError(\"b = 'x'\", 2, \"incompatible comparison points at operator\");\n        // 布尔排序：a < b 中 a 为布尔，错误指向 '<' 偏移 2\n        expectTypeError(\"a < flag\", 2, \"ordering boolean points at operator\");\n\n        // 求值期错误位置：指向具体运算节点\n        expectEvalOffset(\"9223372036854775807 + 1\", 19, \"overflow points at +\");\n        expectEvalOffset(\"1 / 0\", 2, \"division by zero points at /\");\n        expectEvalOffset(\"1 + 2 / 0\", 5, \"nested div zero points at /\");\n        expectEvalOffset(\"-(-9223372036854775808)\", 1, \"negate overflow points at outer -\");\n\n        // 行列换算与指示符\n        String multiLine = \"a = 1\\nAND b = @\";\n        int at = multiLine.indexOf('@');\n        int[] lc = ErrorFormatter.lineAndColumn(multiLine, at);\n        expectEq(2, lc[0], \"@ is on line 2\");\n        expectEq(9, lc[1], \"@ is column 9\");\n        String caret = ErrorFormatter.caret(multiLine, at);\n        check(caret.contains(\"AND b = @\") && caret.contains(\"^\"), \"caret snippet produced\");\n    }\n\n    private <E extends ExpressionException> void expectOffset(\n            Class<E> type, String source, int expectedOffset, String label) {\n        try {\n            Parser.parse(source);\n            fail(label + \" — expected \" + type.getSimpleName() + \" for <\" + source + \">\");\n        } catch (ExpressionException ex) {\n            if (type.isInstance(ex)) {\n                expectEq(expectedOffset, ex.getPosition(),\n                        label + \" offset in <\" + source + \">\");\n            } else {\n                fail(label + \" — expected \" + type.getSimpleName()\n                        + \" but got \" + ex.getClass().getSimpleName());\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    private void expectTypeError(String source, int expectedOffset, String label) {\n        Schema schema = new Schema();\n        schema.add(\"a\", DataType.BOOLEAN);\n        schema.add(\"flag\", DataType.BOOLEAN);\n        schema.add(\"b\", DataType.INTEGER);\n        schema.add(\"s\", DataType.STRING);\n        try {\n            new TypeChecker(schema).check(Parser.parse(source));\n            fail(label + \" — expected TypeException for <\" + source + \">\");\n        } catch (TypeException ex) {\n            expectEq(expectedOffset, ex.getPosition(),\n                    label + \" offset in <\" + source + \">\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    private void expectEvalOffset(String source, int expectedOffset, String label) {\n        try {\n            new Evaluator().evalPredicate(Parser.parse(source), row());\n            fail(label + \" — expected EvalException\");\n        } catch (EvalException ex) {\n            expectEq(expectedOffset, ex.getPosition(),\n                    label + \" offset in <\" + source + \">\");\n        }\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_085380b73032ca693374fc5c","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":2132,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":70456,"output_tokens":1692,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_0y4mgs1x907221avcfoap3ta":{"content":"package
