tvl.parser.Parser;\n\n/** 求值语义：NULL 传播、字符串比较、溢出、除零、IS NULL 与复合表达式。 */\npublic class EvaluatorSemanticsTest extends TestBase {\n\n    private final Evaluator evaluator = new Evaluator();\n\n    private static RowLike row(Object... kv) {\n        Map<String, Object> map = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        for (int i = 0; i < kv.length; i += 2) {\n            map.put((String) kv[i], kv[i + 1]);\n        }\n        return map::get;\n    }\n\n    @Override\n    public String name() {\n        return \"Evaluator semantics\";\n    }\n\n    @Override\n    public void run() {\n        nullArithmetic();\n        integerArithmetic();\n        overflow();\n        division();\n        stringsAndBooleans();\n        compounds();\n        isNullOnExpressions();\n    }\n\n    private void nullArithmetic() {\n        // 任一侧 NULL -> 结果 NULL\n        expectScalar(null, \"i + 1\", row(\"i\", null), \"NULL + 1\");\n        expectScalar(null, \"1 + i\", row(\"i\", null), \"1 + NULL\");\n        expectScalar(null, \"i * j\", row(\"i\", 2L, \"j\", null), \"2 * NULL\");\n        expectScalar(null, \"-i\", row(\"i\", null), \"-NULL\");\n        // NULL 算术短路掉右值除零（与大多数 SQL 一致：左侧 NULL 时结果已是 NULL）\n        expectScalar(null, \"i + (1/0)\", row(\"i\", null), \"NULL + 1/0 -> NULL without error\");\n    }\n\n    private void integerArithmetic() {\n        expectScalar(7L, \"3 + 4\", row(), \"3+4\");\n        expectScalar(-1L, \"3 - 4\", row(), \"3-4\");\n        expectScalar(12L, \"3 * 4\", row(), \"3*4\");\n        expectScalar(2L, \"10 / 4\", row(), \"10/4 truncates toward zero\");\n        expectScalar(-2L, \"-10 / 4\", row(), \"-10/4 truncates toward zero\");\n        expectScalar(3L, \"1 + 2 * 3 - 4\", row(), \"precedence 1+2*3-4\");\n        expectScalar(-5L, \"-(2+3)\", row(), \"-(2+3)\");\n    }\n\n    private void overflow() {\n        expectEvalError(\"9223372036854775807 + 1\", \"max + 1 overflow\");\n        expectEvalError(\"-9223372036854775808 - 1\", \"min - 1 overflow\");\n        expectEvalError(\"9223372036854775807 * 2\", \"max * 2 overflow\");\n        expectEvalError(\"-9223372036854775808 * -1\", \"min * -1 overflow\");\n        expectEvalError(\"-(-9223372036854775808)\", \"negate min overflow\");\n    }\n\n    private void division() {\n        expectEvalError(\"1 / 0\", \"divide by zero\");\n        expectEvalError(\"0 / 0\", \"0 / 0\");\n        expectEvalError(\"-9223372036854775808 / -1\", \"MIN/-1 overflow\");\n    }\n\n    private void stringsAndBooleans() {\n        expectPredicate(Tri.TRUE, \"'abc' = 'abc'\", row(), \"string equality\");\n        expectPredicate(Tri.TRUE, \"'abc' < 'abd'\", row(), \"string ordering\");\n        expectPredicate(Tri.TRUE, \"'B' < 'a'\", row(), \"lexicographic by UTF-16 code unit\");\n        expectPredicate(Tri.TRUE, \"TRUE = TRUE\", row(), \"boolean equality\");\n        expectPredicate(Tri.FALSE, \"TRUE = FALSE\", row(), \"boolean inequality value\");\n        expectPredicate(Tri.TRUE, \"TRUE <> FALSE\", row(), \"boolean <>\");\n    }\n\n    private void compounds() {\n        // (i > 0 AND NOT flag) OR name IS NULL 的全部关键分支\n        String expr = \"(i > 0 AND NOT flag) OR name IS NULL\";\n        expectPredicate(Tri.TRUE, expr, row(\"i\", 5L, \"flag\", false, \"name\", \"x\"),\n                \"T AND T -> T branch\");\n        expectPredicate(Tri.FALSE, expr, row(\"i\", 5L, \"flag\", true, \"name\", \"x\"),\n                \"T AND F, name not null -> F\");\n        expectPredicate(Tri.TRUE, expr, row(\"i\", -1L, \"flag\", true, \"name\", null),\n                \"first clause F, name IS NULL -> T\");\n        expectPredicate(Tri.UNKNOWN, expr, row(\"i\", null, \"flag\", true, \"name\", \"x\"),\n                \"UNKNOWN propagated -> UNKNOWN\");\n        // NOT 与比较\n        expectPredicate(Tri.TRUE, \"NOT (1 = 2)\", row(), \"NOT false\");\n        expectPredicate(Tri.FALSE, \"NOT (1 <> 2)\", row(), \"NOT true\");\n        expectPredicate(Tri.UNKNOWN, \"NOT (1 = i)\", row(\"i\", null), \"NOT UNKNOWN\");\n    }\n\n    private void isNullOnExpressions() {\n        expectPredicate(Tri.TRUE, \"(i + j) IS NULL\", row(\"i\", 1L, \"j\", null),\n                \"result NULL -> IS NULL\");\n        expectPredicate(Tri.FALSE, \"(i + j) IS NOT NULL\", row(\"i\", 1L, \"j\", null),\n                \"result NULL -> IS NOT NULL false\");\n        expectPredicate(Tri.TRUE, \"(i / j) IS NULL\", row(\"i\", 1L, \"j\", null),\n                \"NULL divisor yields NULL, not division error\");\n    }\n\n    private void expectScalar(Object expected, String source, RowLike r, String label) {\n        try {\n            Object actual = evaluator.evalScalar(Parser.parse(source), r);\n            expectEq(expected, actual, label);\n        } catch (EvalException ex) {\n            fail(label + \" — unexpected EvalException: \" + ex.getMessage());\n        }\n    }\n\n    private void expectPredicate(Tri expected, String source, RowLike r, String label) {\n        try {\n            expectEq(expected, evaluator.evalPredicate(Parser.parse(source), r), label);\n        } catch (EvalException ex) {\n            fail(label + \" — unexpected EvalException: \" + ex.getMessage());\n        }\n    }\n\n    private void expectEvalError(String source, String label) {\n        try {\n            evaluator.evalScalar(Parser.parse(source), row());\n            fail(label + \" — expected EvalException\");\n        } catch (EvalException ex) {\n            check(true, label + \": \" + ex.getMessage());\n        }\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_2702b38323752f9b937e9644","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":1684,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":72504,"output_tokens":2770,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_2u11xxrrdsdy1zyrt0yh35o6":{"content":"package private void expectScalar(Object expected, String source, RowLike r, String label) {\n        try {\n            Object actual = evaluator.evalScalar(Parser.parse(source), r);\n            expectEq(expected, actual, label);\n        } catch (EvalException ex) {\n            fail(label + \" — unexpected EvalException: \" + ex.getMessage());\n        }\n    }\n\n    private void expectPredicate(Tri expected, String source, RowLike r, String label) {\n        try {\n            expectEq(expected, evaluator.evalPredicate(Parser.parse(source), r), label);\n        } catch (EvalException ex) {\n            fail(label + \" — unexpected EvalException: \" + ex.getMessage());\n        }\n    }\n\n    private void expectEvalError(String source, String label) {\n        try {\n            evaluator.evalScalar(Parser.parse(source), row());\n            fail(label + \" — expected EvalException\");\n        } catch (EvalException ex) {\n            check(true, label + \": \" + ex.getMessage());\n        }\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"0b65a30a-50a0-4c97-90a3-43441d1662ff","session_id":"0bae1d86-80df-45f1-8b2f-c35225e023c1","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp11/b","sessionId":"0bae1d86-80df-45f1-8b2f-c35225e023c1","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp11-b","slug":"starry-churning-cookie"}

{"parentUuid":"06c7e5e3-9852-43e9-be5a-62a8bb9812ad","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_r2992qdcwqd4i8pexlbp1b8i","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp11/b/test/tvl/test/EngineApiTest.java","content":"package tvl.test;\n\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.LinkedHashMap;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\nimport tvl.api.JsonApi;\nimport tvl.json.Json;\n\n/**\n * 端到端测试：通过 JSON 请求驱动 JsonApi，覆盖\n * 装载、查询、3VL 过滤行计数、select/limit、执行计划统计、导出与全部错误信封。\n */\npublic class EngineApiTest extends TestBase {\n\n    private JsonApi api;\n\n    @Override\n    public String name() {\n        return \"Engine + JSON API end-to-end\";\n    }\n\n    @Override\n    public void run() {\n        api = new JsonApi();\n        loadTable();\n        basicFilteringAnd3vl();\n        selectLimitAndPlan();\n        isNullFiltering();\n        shortCircuitThroughApi();\n        errorsThroughApi();\n        exportAndRoundTrip();\n        batch();\n    }\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ load\n\n    private void loadTable() {\n        // employees(id INTEGER, dept STRING, age INTEGER, active BOOLEAN, mgr_id INTEGER nullable)\n        Map<String, Object> load = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        load.put(\"action\", \"load\");\n        load.put(\"table\", \"employees\");\n        load.put(\"columns\", List.of(\n                col(\"id\", \"INTEGER\"),\n                col(\"dept\", \"STRING\"),\n                col(\"age\", \"INTEGER\"),\n                col(\"active\", \"BOOLEAN\"),\n                col(\"mgr_id\", \"INTEGER\")\n        ));\n        load.put(\"rows\", List.of(\n                row(\"id\", 1, \"dept\", \"eng\", \"age\", 30, \"active\", true, \"mgr_id\", 10),\n                row(\"id\", 2, \"dept\", \"eng\", \"age\", 25, \"active\", false, \"mgr_id\", 10),\n                row(\"id\", 3, \"dept\", \"sales\", \"age\", 40, \"active\", true, \"mgr_id\", null),\n                row(\"id\", 4, \"dept\", \"sales\", \"age\", null, \"active\", true, \"mgr_id\", null),\n                row(\"id\", 5, \"dept\", \"eng\", \"age\", 50, \"active\", null, \"mgr_id\", 20)\n        ));\n        Map<String, Object> resp = api.handle(load);\n        expectEq(true, resp.get(\"ok\"), \"load ok\");\n        expectEq(5, resp.get(\"rowsLoaded\"), \"load row count\");\n\n        // 装载期类型错误\n        Map<String, Object> bad = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        bad.put(\"action\", \"load\");\n        bad.put(\"table\", \"bad\");\n        bad.put(\"columns\", List.of(col(\"x\", \"INTEGER\")));\n        bad.put(\"rows\", List.of(row(\"x\", \"not-a-number\")));\n        Map<String, Object> badResp = api.handle(bad);\n        expectEq(\"TYPE_MISMATCH\", badResp.get(\"error\"), \"load rejects wrong value type\");\n    }\n\n    // -------------------------------------------------------------- filtering\n\n    private void basicFilteringAnd3vl() {\n        // dept='eng' 且 age > 27：行1(30) 命中；行2(25) 不满足；行5 age NULL -> UNKNOWN，剔除\n        Map<String, Object> resp = query(\"dept = 'eng' AND age > 27\", null, null);\n        expectIds(resp, List.of(1L, 5L == 5L ? null : null)); // 占位，下面精确判断\n        // 行5: dept eng, age NULL => ('eng'='eng') AND (NULL>27 => UNKNOWN) = UNKNOWN -> 剔除\n        // 命中只有 id=1\n        List<Long> ids = ids(resp);\n        expectEq(List.of(1L), ids, \"eng AND age>27: FALSE/UNKNOWN excluded\");\n\n        // age NULL 的行用 IS NULL 找回\n        Map<String, Object> resp2 = query(\"age IS NULL\", null, null);\n        expectEq(List.of(4L), ids(resp2), \"age IS NULL finds id 4\");\n\n        // NULL 的反向比较不命中：age <> 40 对 age NULL 是 UNKNOWN\n        Map<String, Object> resp3 = query(\"age <> 40\", null, null);\n        expectEq(List.of(1L, 2L, 5L), ids(resp3),\n                \"age <> 40: NULL rows excluded (UNKNOWN), present rows 1,2,5\");\n\n        // OR 的 UNKNOWN 传播：sales 或 age > 60\n        Map<String, Object> resp4 = query(\"dept = 'sales' OR age > 60\", null, null);\n        expectEq(List.of(3L, 4L), ids(resp4), \"sales OR age>60: sales rows survive\");\n\n        // active 列本身为 NULL 的行：active = TRUE 为 UNKNOWN，剔除\n        Map<String, Object> resp5 = query(\"active = TRUE\", null, null);\n        expectEq(List.of(1L, 3L, 4L), ids(resp5), \"active = TRUE excludes NULL active (id5)\");\n        // IS DISTINCT 风格通过 IS NULL 表达：active IS NOT NULL\n        Map<String, Object> resp6 = query(\"active IS NOT NULL\", null, null);\n        expectEq(List.of(1L, 2L, 3L, 4L), ids(resp6), \"active IS NOT NULL excludes id5\");\n    }\n\n    private void selectLimitAndPlan() {\n        Map<String, Object> resp = query(\"id >= 0\", List.of(\"id\", \"dept\"), 2L);\n        @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n        List<Map<String, Object>> rows = (List<Map<String, Object>>) resp.get(\"rows\");\n        expectEq(2, rows.size(), \"limit 2\");\n        check(rows.get(0).containsKey(\"id\") && !rows.get(0).containsKey(\"age\"),\n                \"projection keeps only requested columns\");\n        expectEq(List.of(1L, 2L), ids(resp), \"limit ordering preserves scan order\");\n\n        @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n        Map<String, Object> stats = (Map<String, Object>) resp.get(\"stats\");\n        expectEq(5, stats.get(\"scanned\"), \"stats.scanned\");\n        expectEq(5, stats.get(\"matched\"), \"stats.matched\");\n        expectEq(2, stats.get(\"returned\"), \"stats.returned\");\n\n        @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n        Map<String, Object> plan = (Map<String, Object>) resp.get(\"plan\");\n        expectEq(\"LIMIT\", plan.get(\"node\"), \"root plan node LIMIT\");\n        expectEq(2L, plan.get(\"rowsOut\"), \"limit rowsOut\");\n        @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n        Map<String, Object> project = (Map<String, Object>) ((List<?>) plan.get(\"children\")).get(0);\n        expectEq(\"PROJECT\", project.get(\"node\"), \"child PROJECT\");\n    }\n\n    private void isNullFiltering() {\n        // mgr_id IS NULL 且 active\n        Map<String, Object> resp = query(\"mgr_id IS NULL AND active = TRUE\", null, null);\n        expectEq(List.of(3L, 4L), ids(resp), \"mgr null AND active\");\n        // mgr_id IS NOT NULL\n        Map<String, Object> resp2 = query(\"mgr_id IS NOT NULL\", null, null);\n        expectEq(List.of(1L, 2L, 5L), ids(resp2), \"mgr not null\");\n    }\n\n    private void shortCircuitThroughApi() {\n        // id = 1 为 FALSE 时短路，右侧除零不触发；加入恒假列条件\n        Map<String, Object> resp = query(\"id = 999 AND (1 / (id - id) = 1)\", null, null);\n        expectEq(true, resp.get(\"ok\"), \"FALSE AND div0 short-circuits, returns ok\");\n        expectEq(List.of(), ids(resp), \"no rows matched\");\n\n        // id 对所有行都不等于 999 -> 全部短路，无除零错误\n        // 反过来，存在 id=1 的行使左侧 TRUE 时，右侧必须求值 -> 除零错误\n        Map<String, Object> resp2 = query(\"id = 1 AND (1 / (id - id) = 1)\", null, null);\n        expectEq(false, resp2.get(\"ok\"), \"TRUE-side forces div0 evaluation -> error\");\n        expectEq(\"EVAL_ERROR\", resp2.get(\"error\"), \"error code EVAL_ERROR\");\n        @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n        Map<String, Object> detail = (Map<String, Object>) resp2.get(\"detail\");\n        check(detail != null && detail.containsKey(\"offset\") && detail.containsKey(\"snippet\"),\n                \"eval error carries offset and snippet\");\n    }\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ errors\n\n    private void errorsThroughApi() {\n        expectEq(\"INVALID_JSON\",\n                ((Map<String, Object>) Json.parse(api.handleJson(\"{not json\"))).get(\"error\"),\n                \"invalid JSON envelope\");\n\n        expectEq(\"PARSE_ERROR\", queryRaw(\"id ==\").get(\"error\"), \"parse error via API\");\n        expectEq(\"TYPE_ERROR\", queryRaw(\"id = 'x'\").get(\"error\"), \"type error via API\");\n        expectEq(\"LEX_ERROR\", queryRaw(\"id @@ 1\").get(\"error\"), \"lex error via API\");\n\n        Map<String, Object> unknownTable = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        unknownTable.put(\"action\", \"query\");\n        unknownTable.put(\"table\", \"nope\");\n        expectEq(\"UNKNOWN_TABLE\", api.handle(unknownTable).get(\"error\"), \"unknown table\");\n\n        Map<String, Object> unknownAction = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        unknownAction.put(\"action\", \"frobnicate\");\n        expectEq(\"INVALID_REQUEST\", api.handle(unknownAction).get(\"error\"), \"unknown action\");\n\n        Map<String, Object> unknownColSelect = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        unknownColSelect.put(\"action\", \"query\");\n        unknownColSelect.put(\"table\", \"employees\");\n        unknownColSelect.put(\"select\", List.of(\"nope\"));\n        expectEq(\"ENGINE_ERROR\", api.handle(unknownColSelect).get(\"error\"),\n                \"unknown projected column\");\n    }\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ export\n\n    private void exportAndRoundTrip() {\n        Map<String, Object> exportReq = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        exportReq.put(\"action\", \"export\");\n        Map<String, Object> exported = api.handle(exportReq);\n        expectEq(true, exported.get(\"ok\"), \"export ok\");\n        @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n        List<Map<String, Object>> tables = (List<Map<String, Object>>) exported.get(\"tables\");\n        expectEq(1, tables.size(), \"export one table\");\n        Map<String, Object> empTable = tables.get(0);\n        expectEq(\"employees\", empTable.get(\"name\"), \"export table name\");\n        expectEq(5, empTable.get(\"rowCount\"), \"export row count\");\n\n        // 导出的 NULL 仍然为 null\n        @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n        List<Map<String, Object>> rows =\n                (List<Map<String, Object>>) empTable.get(\"rows\");\n        check(rows.get(2).get(\"mgr_id\") == null, \"exported null survives as JSON null\");\n\n        // 导出的内容可以重新装载（表改名）形成往返\n        @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n        List<Map<String, Object>> columns =\n                (List<Map<String, Object>>) empTable.get(\"columns\");\n        Map<String, Object> reload = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        reload.put(\"action\", \"load\");\n        reload.put(\"table\", \"employees_copy\");\n        reload.put(\"columns\", columns);\n        reload.put(\"rows\", rows);\n        expectEq(true, api.handle(reload).get(\"ok\"), \"exported data reloads (round-trip)\");\n    }\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------- batch\n\n    private void batch() {\n        String jsonLines =\n                \"{\\\"action\\\":\\\"load\\\",\\\"table\\\":\\\"t\\\",\"\n                        + \"\\\"columns\\\":[{\\\"name\\\":\\\"x\\\",\\\"type\\\":\\\"INTEGER\\\"}],\"\n                        + \"\\\"rows\\\":[{\\\"x\\\":1},{\\\"x\\\":2},{\\\"x\\\":3}]}\\n\"\n                        + \"{\\\"action\\\":\\\"query\\\",\\\"table\\\":\\\"t\\\",\\\"where\\\":\\\"x > 1\\\"}\\n\"\n                        + \"{\\\"action\\\":\\\"export\\\",\\\"table\\\":\\\"t\\\"}\";\n        String out = api.handleJson(jsonLines.contains(\"\\n\") ? wrapBatch(jsonLines) : jsonLines);\n        // handleJson 只收单对象；批量路径通过 Main 间接验证，这里直接顺序调用模拟\n        Map<String, Object> load = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        load.put(\"action\", \"load\");\n        load.put(\"table\", \"t2\");\n        load.put(\"columns\", List.of(col(\"x\", \"INTEGER\")));\n        load.put(\"rows\", List.of(row(\"x\", 1), row(\"x\", 2)));\n        expectEq(true, api.handle(load).get(\"ok\"), \"batch-style load\");\n        Map<String, Object> q = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        q.put(\"action\", \"query\");\n        q.put(\"table\", \"t2\");\n        q.put(\"where\", \"x = 2\");\n        Map<String, Object> qr = api.handle(q);\n        expectEq(1, qr.get(\"rowCount\"), \"batch-style query shares state\");\n    }\n\n    private String wrapBatch(String ignored) {\n        return \"{}\";\n    }\n\n    // ----------------------------------------------------------------- helpers\n\n    private Map<String, Object> query(String where, List<String> select, Long limit) {\n        Map<String, Object> req = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        req.put(\"action\", \"query\");\n        req.put(\"table\", \"employees\");\n        if (where != null) req.put(\"where\", where);\n        if (select != null) req.put(\"select\", select);\n        if (limit != null) req.put(\"limit\", limit);\n        Map<String, Object> resp = api.handle(req);\n        if (!Boolean.TRUE.equals(resp.get(\"ok\"))) {\n            fail(\"query unexpectedly failed: \" + resp);\n        }\n        return resp;\n    }\n\n    private Map<String, Object> queryRaw(String where) {\n        return api.handleJson(\n                \"{\\\"action\\\":\\\"query\\\",\\\"table\\\":\\\"employees\\\",\\\"where\\\":\\\"\"\n                        + where.replace(\"\\\"\", \"\\\\\\\"\") + \"\\\"}\");\n    }\n\n    @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n    private List<Long> ids(Map<String, Object> queryResp) {\n        List<Long> ids = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (Object o : (List<?>) queryResp.get(\"rows\")) {\n            Map<String, Object> r = (Map<String, Object>) o;\n            Object id = r.get(\"id\");\n            if (id != null) ids.add((Long) id);\n        }\n        return ids;\n    }\n\n    private void expectIds(Map<String, Object> resp, List<Long> ignored) {\n        // 占位辅助，实际断言在调用处用 ids()\n    }\n\n    private static Map<String, Object> col(String name, String type) {\n        Map<String, Object> c = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        c.put(\"name\", name);\n        c.put(\"type\", type);\n        return c;\n    }\n\n    private static Map<String, Object> row(Object... kv) {\n        Map<String, Object> r = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        for (int i = 0; i < kv.length; i += 2) {\n            r.put((String) kv[i], kv[i + 1]);\n        }\n        return r;\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_60ef25eabc40b233f9680756","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":3462,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":73528,"output_tokens":3754,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_r2992qdcwqd4i8pexlbp1b8i":{"content":"package return \"Engine + JSON API end-to-end\";\n    }\n\n    @Override\n    public void run() {\n        api = new JsonApi();\n        loadTable();\n        basicFilteringAnd3vl();\n        selectLimitAndPlan();\n        isNullFiltering();\n        shortCircuitThroughApi();\n        errorsThroughApi();\n        exportAndRoundTrip();\n        batch();\n    }\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ load\n\n    private void loadTable() {\n        // employees(id INTEGER, dept STRING, age INTEGER, active BOOLEAN, mgr_id INTEGER nullable)\n        Map<String, Object> load = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        load.put(\"action\", \"load\");\n        load.put(\"table\", \"employees\");\n        load.put(\"columns\", List.of(\n                col(\"id\", \"INTEGER\"),\n                col(\"dept\", \"STRING\"),\n                col(\"age\", \"INTEGER\"),\n                col(\"active\", \"BOOLEAN\"),\n                col(\"mgr_id\", \"INTEGER\")\n        ));\n        load.put(\"rows\", List.of(\n                row(\"id\", 1, \"dept\", \"eng\", \"age\", 30, \"active\", true, \"mgr_id\", 10),\n                row(\"id\", 2, \"dept\", \"eng\", \"age\", 25, \"active\", false, \"mgr_id\", 10),\n                row(\"id\", 3, \"dept\", \"sales\", \"age\", 40, \"active\", true, \"mgr_id\", null),\n                row(\"id\", 4, \"dept\", \"sales\", \"age\", null, \"active\", true, \"mgr_id\", null),\n                row(\"id\", 5, \"dept\", \"eng\", \"age\", 50, \"active\", null, \"mgr_id\", 20)\n        ));\n        Map<String, Object> resp = api.handle(load);\n        expectEq(true, resp.get(\"ok\"), \"load ok\");\n        expectEq(5, resp.get(\"rowsLoaded\"), \"load row count\");\n\n        // 装载期类型错误\n        Map<String, Object> bad = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        bad.put(\"action\", \"load\");\n        bad.put(\"table\", \"bad\");\n        bad.put(\"columns\", List.of(col(\"x\", \"INTEGER\")));\n        bad.put(\"rows\", List.of(row(\"x\", \"not-a-number\")));\n        Map<String, Object> badResp = api.handle(bad);\n        expectEq(\"TYPE_MISMATCH\", badResp.get(\"error\"), \"load rejects wrong value type\");\n    }\n\n    // -------------------------------------------------------------- filtering\n\n    private void basicFilteringAnd3vl() {\n        // dept='eng' 且 age > 27：行1(30) 命中；行2(25) 不满足；行5 age NULL -> UNKNOWN，剔除\n        Map<String, Object> resp = query(\"dept = 'eng' AND age > 27\", null, null);\n        expectIds(resp, List.of(1L, 5L == 5L ? null : null)); // 占位，下面精确判断\n        // 行5: dept eng, age NULL => ('eng'='eng') AND (NULL>27 => UNKNOWN) = UNKNOWN -> 剔除\n        // 命中只有 id=1\n        List<Long> ids = ids(resp);\n        expectEq(List.of(1L), ids, \"eng AND age>27: FALSE/UNKNOWN excluded\");\n\n        // age NULL 的行用 IS NULL 找回\n        Map<String, Object> resp2 = query(\"age IS NULL\", null, null);\n        expectEq(List.of(4L), ids(resp2), \"age IS NULL finds id 4\");\n\n        // NULL 的反向比较不命中：age <> 40 对 age NULL 是 UNKNOWN\n        Map<String, Object> resp3 = query(\"age <> 40\", null, null);\n        expectEq(List.of(1L, 2L, 5L), ids(resp3),\n                \"age <> 40: NULL rows excluded (UNKNOWN), present rows 1,2,5\");\n\n        // OR 的 UNKNOWN 传播：sales 或 age > 60\n        Map<String, Object> resp4 = query(\"dept = 'sales' OR age > 60\", null, null);\n        expectEq(List.of(3L, 4L), ids(resp4), \"sales OR age>60: sales rows survive\");\n\n        // active 列本身为 NULL 的行：active = TRUE 为 UNKNOWN，剔除\n        Map<String, Object> resp5 = query(\"active = TRUE\", null, null);\n        expectEq(List.of(1L, 3L, 4L), ids(resp5), \"active = TRUE excludes NULL active (id5)\");\n        // IS DISTINCT 风格通过 IS NULL 表达：active IS NOT NULL\n        Map<String, Object> resp6 = query(\"active IS NOT NULL\", null, null);\n        expectEq(List.of(1L, 2L, 3L, 4L), ids(resp6), \"active IS NOT NULL excludes id5\");\n    }\n\n    private void selectLimitAndPlan() {\n        Map<String, Object> resp = query(\"id >= 0\", List.of(\"id\", \"dept\"), 2L);\n        @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n        List<Map<String, Object>> rows = (List<Map<String, Object>>) resp.get(\"rows\");\n        expectEq(2, rows.size(), \"limit 2\");\n        check(rows.get(0).containsKey(\"id\") && !rows.get(0).containsKey(\"age\"),\n                \"projection keeps only requested columns\");\n        expectEq(List.of(1L, 2L), ids(resp), \"limit ordering preserves scan order\");\n\n        @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n        Map<String, Object> stats = (Map<String, Object>) resp.get(\"stats\");\n        expectEq(5, stats.get(\"scanned\"), \"stats.scanned\");\n        expectEq(5, stats.get(\"matched\"), \"stats.matched\");\n        expectEq(2, stats.get(\"returned\"), \"stats.returned\");\n\n        @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n        Map<String, Object> plan = (Map<String, Object>) selectLimitAndPlan();\n        isNullFiltering();\n        shortCircuitThroughApi();\n        errorsThroughApi();\n        exportAndRoundTrip();\n        batch();\n    }\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ load\n\n    private void loadTable() {\n        // employees(id INTEGER, dept STRING, age INTEGER, active BOOLEAN, mgr_id INTEGER nullable)\n        Map<String, Object> load = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        load.put(\"action\", \"load\");\n        load.put(\"table\", \"employees\");\n        load.put(\"columns\", List.of(\n                col(\"id\", \"INTEGER\"),\n                col(\"dept\", \"STRING\"),\n                col(\"age\", \"INTEGER\"),\n                col(\"active\", \"BOOLEAN\"),\n                col(\"mgr_id\", \"INTEGER\")\n        ));\n        load.put(\"rows\", List.of(\n                row(\"id\", 1, \"dept\", \"eng\", \"age\", 30, \"active\", true, \"mgr_id\", 10),\n                row(\"id\", 2, \"dept\", \"eng\", \"age\", 25, \"active\", false, \"mgr_id\", 10),\n                row(\"id\", 3, \"dept\", \"sales\", \"age\", 40, \"active\", true, \"mgr_id\", null),\n                row(\"id\", 4, \"dept\", \"sales\", \"age\", null, \"active\", true, \"mgr_id\", null),\n                row(\"id\", 5, \"dept\", \"eng\", \"age\", 50, \"active\", null, \"mgr_id\", 20)\n        ));\n        Map<String, Object> resp = api.handle(load);\n        expectEq(true, resp.get(\"ok\"), \"load ok\");\n        expectEq(5, resp.get(\"rowsLoaded\"), \"load row count\");\n\n        // 装载期类型错误\n        Map<String, Object> bad = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        bad.put(\"action\", \"load\");\n        bad.put(\"table\", \"bad\");\n        bad.put(\"columns\", List.of(col(\"x\", \"INTEGER\")));\n        bad.put(\"rows\", List.of(row(\"x\", \"not-a-number\")));\n        Map<String, Object> badResp = api.handle(bad);\n        expectEq(\"TYPE_MISMATCH\", badResp.get(\"error\"), \"load rejects wrong value type\");\n    }\n\n    // -------------------------------------------------------------- filtering\n\n    private void basicFilteringAnd3vl() {\n        // dept='eng' 且 age > 27：行1(30) 命中；行2(25) 不满足；行5 age NULL -> UNKNOWN，剔除\n        Map<String, Object> resp = query(\"dept = 'eng' AND age > 27\", null, null);\n        expectIds(resp, List.of(1L, 5L == 5L ? null : null)); // 占位，下面精确判断\n        // 行5: dept eng, age NULL => ('eng'='eng') AND (NULL>27 => UNKNOWN) = UNKNOWN -> 剔除\n        // 命中只有 id=1\n        List<Long> ids = ids(resp);\n        expectEq(List.of(1L), ids, \"eng AND age>27: FALSE/UNKNOWN excluded\");\n\n        // age NULL 的行用 IS NULL 找回\n        Map<String, Object> resp2 = query(\"age IS NULL\", null, null);\n        expectEq(List.of(4L), ids(resp2), \"age IS NULL finds id 4\");\n\n        // NULL 的反向比较不命中：age <> 40 对 age NULL 是 UNKNOWN\n        Map<String, Object> resp3 = query(\"age <> 40\", null, null);\n        expectEq(List.of(1L, 2L, 5L), ids(resp3),\n                \"age <> 40: NULL rows excluded (UNKNOWN), present rows 1,2,5\");\n\n        // OR 的 UNKNOWN 传播：sales 或 age > 60\n        Map<String, Object> resp4 = query(\"dept = 'sales' OR age > 60\", null, null);\n        expectEq(List.of(3L, 4L), ids(resp4), \"sales OR age>60: sales rows survive\");\n\n        // active 列本身为 NULL 的行：active = TRUE 为 UNKNOWN，剔除\n        Map<String, Object> resp5 = query(\"active = TRUE\", null, null);\n        expectEq(List.of(1L, 3L, 4L), ids(resp5), \"active = TRUE excludes NULL active (id5)\");\n        // IS DISTINCT 风格通过 IS NULL 表达：active IS NOT NULL\n        Map<String, Object> resp6 = query(\"active IS NOT NULL\", null, null);\n        expectEq(List.of(1L, 2L, 3L, 4L), ids(resp6), \"active IS NOT NULL excludes id5\");\n types();\n        escapes();\n        malformed();\n    }\n\n    private void roundTrips() {\n        Map<String, Object> obj = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        obj.put(\"name\", \"ada\");\n private Expr parseOr() {\n        Expr left = parseAnd();\n        while (current.type() == TokenType.OR) {\n            Token op = current;\n            advance();\n            Expr right = parseAnd();\n            left = new Expr.Logical(Expr.LogicalOp.OR, left, right, op.pos());\n        }\n        return left;\n    }\n\n    private Expr parseAnd() {\n        Expr left = parseNot();\n        while (current.type() == TokenType.AND) {\n            Token op = current;\n            advance();\n            Expr right = parseNot();\n            left = new Expr.Logical(Expr.LogicalOp.AND, left, right, op.pos());\n        }\n        return left;\n    }\n\n    private Expr parseNot() {\n        if (current.type() == TokenType.NOT) {\n            Token op = current;\n            advance();\n            return new Expr.Not(parseNot(), op.pos());\n        }\n        return parsePredicate();\n    }\n\n    private Expr parsePredicate() {\n        Expr expr = parseComparison();\n        if (current.type() == TokenType.IS) {\n            Token is = current;\n            advance();\n            boolean negated = false;\n            if (current.type() == TokenType.NOT) {\n NULL after IS \" + (negated ? \"NOT \" : \"\"),\n                        current.pos());\n            }\n            advance();\n            expr = new Expr.IsNull(expr, negated, is.pos());\n        }\n        return expr;\n    }\n\n    private Expr parseComparison() {\n        Expr left = parseAdditive();\n        Expr.CompareOp op = switch (current.type()) {\n            case EQ -> Expr.CompareOp.EQ;\n            case NE -> Expr.CompareOp.NE;\n            case LT -> Expr.CompareOp.LT;\n            case LE -> Expr.CompareOp.LE;\n            case GT -> Expr.CompareOp.GT;\n            case GE -> Expr.CompareOp.GE;\n            default -> null;\n        };\n        if (op == null) {\n            return left;\n        }\n        Token opToken = current;\n        advance();\n        Expr right = parseAdditive();\n        Expr comparison = new Expr.Compare(op, left, right, opToken.pos());\n        // 链式比较 a < b < c：第二个比较符在此处被发现\n        if (isComparisonOperator(current.type())) TokenType.LE || t == TokenType.GT || t == TokenType.GE;\n    }\n\n    private Expr parseAdditive() {\n        Expr left = parseTerm();\n        while (current.type() == TokenType.PLUS || &lt;= &gt; &gt;=，算术 + - * /，括号\n *\n * 空白（空格、制表符、换行）被跳过，行号列号随源码保留以便定位错误。\n */\npublic final class Lexer {\n\n    private static final Map<String, TokenType> KEYWORDS = Map.of(\n            \"and\", TokenType.AND,\n            \"or\", TokenType.OR,\n            \"not\", TokenType.NOT,\n            \"is\", TokenType.IS,\n            \"null\", TokenType.NULL,\n            \"true\", TokenType.TRUE,\n            \"false\", TokenType.FALSE,\n            \"unknown\", TokenType.UNKNOWN\n    );\n\n    private final String src;\n    private int pos;\n    private int line = 1;\n    private int column = 1;\n\n    public Lexer(String src) {\n        this.src = src;\n    }\n\n    public Token next() {\n        skipWhitespaceAndComments();\n        if (pos >= src.length()) {\n            return new Token(TokenType.EOF, \"\", pos, line, column);\n        }\n        int startPos = pos;\n        int startLine = line;\n        int startColumn = column;\n        char c = src.charAt(pos);\n\n        if (Character.isDigit(c)) {\n            return readNumber(startPos, startLine, startColumn);\n        }\n        if (isIdentStart(c)) {\n            return readIdentifier(startPos, startLine, startColumn);\n        }\n        if (c == '\\'') {\n            return readString(startPos, startLine, startColumn);\n        }\n        return readOperator(startPos, startLine, startColumn);\n    }\n\n    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    private void skipWhitespaceAndComments() {\n        while (pos < src.length()) {\n            char c = src.charAt(pos);\n            if (c == ' ' || c == '\\t' || c == '\\r') {\n                advance();\n            } else if (c == '\\n') {\n                advance(); // advance() 内部更新行号\n            } else {\n                break;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    private Token readNumber(int startPos, int startLine, int startColumn) {\n        StringBuilder digits = new StringBuilder();\n        while (pos < src.length() && Character.isDigit(src.charAt(pos))) {\n            digits.append(src.charAt(pos));\n            advance();\n        }\n        String token = digits.toString();\n        long value;\n        if (token.equals(MIN_LONG_DIGITS)) {\n            // 唯一一个不能写成正数、但在一元负号后合法的字面量：-9223372036854775808\n            // 交给 Parser.parseUnary 处理；不带负号直接出现时在解析期报错。\n            return new Token(TokenType.INTEGER, token, 0L, startPos, startLine, startColumn);\n        }\n        try {\n            value = Long.parseLong(token);\n        } catch (NumberFormatException ex) {\n            throw new LexException(\n                    \"integer literal '\" + token + \"' is out of 64-bit range\", startPos);\n        }\n        return new Token(TokenType.INTEGER, token, value, startPos, startLine, startColumn);\n    }\n\n    /** 9223372036854775808 = |Long.MIN_VALUE|，仅允许出现在一元负号之后。 */\n    static final String MIN_LONG_DIGITS = \"9223372036854775808\";\n\n    private Token readIdentifier(int startPos, int startLine, int startColumn) {\n        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();\n        while (pos < src.length() && isIdentPart(src.charAt(pos))) {\n            sb.append(src.charAt(pos));\n            advance();\n        }\n        String word = sb.toString();\n        TokenType kw = KEYWORDS.get(word.toLowerCase());\n        if (kw != null) {\n            return new Token(kw, word, startPos, startLine, startColumn);\n        }\n        return new Token(TokenType.IDENT, word, startPos, startLine, startColumn);\n    }\n\n    private Token readString(int startPos, int startLine, int startColumn) {\n        advance(); // 跳过起始引号\n        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();\n        while (true) {\n            if (pos >= src.length()) {\n                throw new LexException(\"unterminated string literal (missing closing ') \", startPos);\n            }\n            char c = src.charAt(pos);\n            if (c == '\\'') {\n                advance();\n                // SQL 风格：连续两个单引号表示一个单引号\n                if (pos < src.length() && src.charAt(pos) == '\\'') {\n                    sb.append('\\'');\n                    advance();\n                } else {\n                    break;\n                }\n            } else {\n                sb.append(c);\n                advance();\n            }\n        }\n        return new Token(TokenType.STRING, sb.toString(), startPos, startLine, startColumn);\n    }\n\n    private Token readOperator(int startPos, int startLine, int startColumn) {\n        char c = src.charAt(pos);\n        switch (c) {\n            case '(' -> {\n                advance();\n                return token(TokenType.LPAREN, \"(\", startPos, startLine, startColumn);\n            }\n            case ')' -> {\n                advance();\n                return token(TokenType.RPAREN, \")\", startPos, startLine, startColumn);\n            }\n            case '+' -> {\n                advance();\n                return token(TokenType.PLUS, \"+\", startPos, startLine, startColumn);\n            }\n            case '-' -> {\n                advance();\n                return token(TokenType.MINUS, \"-\", startPos, startLine, startColumn);\n            }\n            case '*' -> {\n                advance();\n                return token(TokenType.STAR, \"*\", startPos, startLine, startColumn);\n            }\n            case '/' -> {\n                advance();\n                return token(TokenType.SLASH, \"/\", startPos, startLine, startColumn);\n            }\n            case '=' -> {\n                advance();\n                consumeIf('='); Parser(String source) {\n        this.source = source;\n        this.lexer = new Lexer(source);\n        this.current = lexer.next();\n    }\n\n    public static Expr parse(String source) {\n p.current.text() + \"' after complete expression\",\n                    p.current.pos());\n        }\n        return expr;\n    }\n\n    private Expr parseOr() {\n        Expr left = parseAnd();\n op = current;\n            advance();\n            Expr right = parseNot();\n            left = new Expr.Logical(Expr.LogicalOp.AND, left, right, op.pos());\n        }\n        return left;\n    }\n\n    private Expr parseNot() {\n        if (current.type() == TokenType.NOT) {\n            Token op = current;\n            advance();\n            return new Expr.Not(parseNot(), op.pos());\n        }\n        return parsePredicate();\n    }\n\n    private Expr parsePredicate() {\n        Expr expr = parseComparison();\n        if (current.type() == TokenType.IS) {\n            Token is =        Expr left = parseAdditive();\n        Expr.CompareOp op = switch (current.type()) {\n            case EQ -> Expr.CompareOp.EQ;\n            case NE -> Expr.CompareOp.NE;\n            case LT -> Expr.CompareOp.LT;\n            case LE -> Expr.CompareOp.LE;\n            case GT -> Expr.CompareOp.GT;\n            case GE -> Expr.CompareOp.GE;\n            default -> null;\n        };\n        if (op == null) {\n            return left;\n        }\n        Token opToken = current;\n        advance();\n        Expr right = parseAdditive();\n        Expr comparison = new Expr.Compare(op, left, right, opToken.pos());\n        // 链式比较 a < b < c：第二个比较符在此处被发现\n        if (isComparisonOperator(current.type())) {\n            throw new ParseException(\n                    \"chained comparisons are not allowed (did you mean to combine them with AND?)\",\n                    current.pos());\n        }\n        return comparison;\n    }\n\n    private static boolean isComparisonOperator(TokenType t) {\n        return t == TokenType.EQ || t == TokenType.NE || t == TokenType.LT\n                || t == TokenType.LE || t == TokenType.GT || t == TokenType.GE;\n    }\n\n    private Expr parseAdditive() {\n        Expr left = parseTerm();\n        while (current.type() == TokenType.PLUS || current.type() == TokenType.MINUS) {\n            Token op = current;\n AND notExpr )*\n * notExpr      := NOT notExpr | predicate\n * predicate    := comparison ( IS [NOT] NULL )?\n * comparison   := additive ((=|==|&lt;&gt;|!=|&lt;|&lt;=|&gt;|&gt;=) additive)?\n * additive     := term ((+ | -) term)*\n * term         := unary ((* | /) unary)*\n * unary        := -unary | primary\n * primary      := INTEGER | STRING | NULL | TRUE | FALSE | UNKNOWN | IDENT | '(' orExpr ')'\n * </pre>\n *\n * 不允许链式比较（如 {@code a < b < c}）；不允许比较结果做算术；\n * 这些约束的一部分在解析期发现，其余在类型检查期发现。\n */\npublic final class Parser {\n\n    private final String source;\n    private final Lexer lexer;\n    private Token current;\n\n    public Parser(String source) {\n        this.source = source;\n        this.lexer = new Lexer(source);\n        this.current = lexer.next();\n    }\n\n private Expr parseOr() {\n        Expr left = parseAnd();\n        while (current.type() == TokenType.OR) {\n            Token op = current;\n            advance();\n            Expr right = parseAnd();\n            left = new Expr.Logical(Expr.LogicalOp.OR, left, right, op.pos());\n        }\n        return left;\n    }\n\n    private Expr parseAnd() {\n        Expr left = parseNot();\n        while (current.type() == TokenType.AND) {\n            Token op = current;\n            advance();\n            Expr right = parseNot();\n            left = new Expr.Logical(Expr.LogicalOp.AND, left, right, op.pos());\n        }\n        return left;\n    }\n\n    private Expr parseNot() {\n        if (current.type() == TokenType.NOT) {\n            Token op = current;\n            advance();\n            return new Expr.Not(parseNot(), op.pos());\n        }\n        return parsePredicate();\n    }\n\n    private Expr parsePredicate() {\n        Expr expr = parseComparison();\n        if (current.type() == TokenType.IS) {\n            Token is = current;\n            advance();\n            boolean negated = false;\n            if (current.type() == TokenType.NOT) {\n }\n        return expr;\n    }\n\n    private Expr parseComparison() {\n        Expr left = parseAdditive();\n        Expr.CompareOp op = switch (current.type()) {\n            case EQ -> Expr.CompareOp.EQ;\n            case NE -> Expr.CompareOp.NE;\n            case LT -> Expr.CompareOp.LT;\n            case LE -> Expr.CompareOp.LE;\n            case GT -> Expr.CompareOp.GT;\n {\n            throw new ParseException(\n                    \"chained comparisons are not allowed (did you mean to combine them with AND?)\",\n                    current.pos());\n        }\n        return comparison;\n    }\n\n    private static boolean isComparisonOperator(TokenType t) {\n        return t == TokenType.EQ || t == TokenType.NE || t == TokenType.LT\n                || t == TokenType.LE || t == TokenType.GT || t == TokenType.GE;\n    }\n\n    private Expr parseAdditive() {\n        Expr left = parseTerm();\n        while (current.type() == TokenType.PLUS || current.type() == TokenType.MINUS) {\n            Token op = current;\n            advance();\n            Expr right = parseTerm();\n            Expr.ArithOp arithOp = op.type() == TokenType.PLUS\n Expr.ArithOp.ADD : Expr.ArithOp.SUB;\n            left = new Expr.BinaryArith(arithOp, left, right, op.pos());\n        }\n        return left;\n    }\n\n    private Expr parseTerm() {\n        Expr left = parseUnary();\n        while (current.type() == TokenType.STAR || current.type() == TokenType.SLASH) {\n            Token op = current;\n            advance();\n            Expr right = parseUnary();\n            Expr.ArithOp arithOp = op.type() == TokenType.STAR\n                    ? \"UNKNOWN literal\");\n        expectEq(Tri.UNKNOWN,\n                evaluator.evalPredicate(Parser.parse(\"NOT UNKNOWN\"), row()), \"NOT UNKNOWN\");","originalFile":"package tvl.test;\n\nimport java.util.LinkedHashMap;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\nimport tvl.evaluator.EvalException;\nimport tvl.evaluator.Evaluator;\nimport tvl.evaluator.RowLike;\nimport tvl.expr.Expr;\nimport tvl.expr.Tri;\nimport tvl.parser.Parser;\n\n/**\n * 穷举三值逻辑真值表（AND/OR 各 3x3=9 格，NOT 3 格），\n * 并覆盖 IS NULL 真值表、短路除零与 NULL 参与比较。\n */\npublic class TruthTablesTest extends TestBase {\n\n    private final Evaluator evaluator = new Evaluator();\n\n    /** 用内存 Map 实现行，null 即 SQL NULL。 */\n    private static RowLike row(Object... kv) {\n        Map<String, Object> map = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        for (int i = 0; i < kv.length; i += 2) {\n            map.put((String) kv[i], kv[i + 1]);\n        }\n        return map::get;\n    }\n\n    private static final Boolean T = Boolean.TRUE;\n    private static final Boolean F = Boolean.FALSE;\n\n    @Override\n    public String name() {\n        return \"Exhaustive 3VL truth tables\";\n    }\n\n    @Override\n    public void run() {\n        andTruthTable();\n        orTruthTable();\n        notTruthTable();\n        isNullTruthTable();\n        shortCircuit();\n        nullComparisons();\n        literalUnknown();\n    }\n\n    private void andTruthTable() {\n        // 列 a、b 取值：TRUE / FALSE / null(UNKNOWN)\n        Boolean[] values = {T, F, null};\n        // SQL AND 参考真值表，索引顺序 TRUE, FALSE, UNKNOWN\n        Tri[][] expected = {\n                {Tri.TRUE,  Tri.FALSE,   Tri.UNKNOWN}, // a = TRUE\n                {Tri.FALSE, Tri.FALSE,   Tri.FALSE},   // a = FALSE\n                {Tri.UNKNOWN, Tri.FALSE, Tri.UNKNOWN}, // a = UNKNOWN\n        };\n        Expr expr = Parser.parse(\"a AND b\");\n        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {\n            for (int j = 0; j < 3; j++) {\n                Tri actual = evaluator.evalPredicate(expr, row(\"a\", values[i], \"b\", values[j]));\n                expectEq(expected[i][j], actual,\n                        \"AND(\" + triName(values[i]) + \",\" + triName(values[j]) + \")\");\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    private void orTruthTable() {\n        Boolean[] values = {T, F, null};\n        Tri[][] expected = {\n                {Tri.TRUE,  Tri.TRUE,  Tri.TRUE},    // a = TRUE\n                {Tri.TRUE,  Tri.FALSE, Tri.UNKNOWN}, // a = FALSE\n                {Tri.TRUE,  Tri.UNKNOWN, Tri.UNKNOWN}, // a = UNKNOWN\n        };\n        Expr expr = Parser.parse(\"a OR b\");\n        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {\n            for (int j = 0; j < 3; j++) {\n                Tri actual = evaluator.evalPredicate(expr, row(\"a\", values[i], \"b\", values[j]));\n                expectEq(expected[i][j], actual,\n                        \"OR(\" + triName(values[i]) + \",\" + triName(values[j]) + \")\");\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    private void notTruthTable() {\n        Boolean[] values = {T, F, null};\n        Tri[] expected = {Tri.FALSE, Tri.TRUE, Tri.UNKNOWN};\n        Expr expr = Parser.parse(\"NOT a\");\n        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {\n            Tri actual = evaluator.evalPredicate(expr, row(\"a\", values[i]));\n            expectEq(expected[i], actual, \"NOT(\" + triName(values[i]) + \")\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    private void isNullTruthTable() {\n        // x 取非空整数与 NULL，穷举 IS NULL / IS NOT NULL\n        Expr isNull = Parser.parse(\"x IS NULL\");\n        Expr isNotNull = Parser.parse(\"x IS NOT NULL\");\n        expectEq(Tri.TRUE, evaluator.evalPredicate(isNull, row(\"x\", null)), \"NULL IS NULL\");\n        expectEq(Tri.FALSE, evaluator.evalPredicate(isNull, row(\"x\", 5L)), \"5 IS NULL\");\n        expectEq(Tri.FALSE, evaluator.evalPredicate(isNotNull, row(\"x\", null)), \"NULL IS NOT NULL\");\n        expectEq(Tri.TRUE, evaluator.evalPredicate(isNotNull, row(\"x\", 5L)), \"5 IS NOT NULL\");\n        // IS NULL 绝不受 3VL UNKNOWN 影响\n        Expr complex = Parser.parse(\"(x = 1) IS NULL\");\n        expectEq(Tri.TRUE, evaluator.evalPredicate(complex, row(\"x\", null)), \"(NULL=1) IS NULL\");\n        expectEq(Tri.FALSE, evaluator.evalPredicate(complex, row(\"x\", 1L)), \"(1=1) IS NULL\");\n    }\n\n    private void shortCircuit() {\n        // 右操作数含除零：1 / x = 1\n        Expr and = Parser.parse(\"a AND (1 / x = 1)\");\n        Expr or = Parser.parse(\"a OR (1 / x = 1)\");\n\n        // AND 左值 FALSE -> 短路，右值（含除零）绝不求值\n        expectEq(Tri.FALSE, evaluator.evalPredicate(and, row(\"a\", F, \"x\", 0L)),\n                \"FALSE AND 1/0 -> FALSE, no error (short-circuit)\");\n        // AND 左值 TRUE -> 必须求值右值 -> 除零错误\n        expectThrowsEval(\"TRUE AND 1/0\", () ->\n                evaluator.evalPredicate(and, row(\"a\", T, \"x\", 0L)));\n        // AND 左值 UNKNOWN -> 结果取决于右值，必须求值 -> 除零错误（不短路）\n        expectThrowsEval(\"UNKNOWN AND 1/0\", () ->\n                evaluator.evalPredicate(and, row(\"a\", null, \"x\", 0L)));\n        // 左 UNKNOWN、右值正常求值为 TRUE -> UNKNOWN AND TRUE => UNKNOWN\n        expectEq(Tri.UNKNOWN, evaluator.evalPredicate(and, row(\"a\", null, \"x\", 1L)),\n                \"UNKNOWN AND TRUE -> UNKNOWN\");\n\n        // OR 左值 TRUE -> 短路\n        expectEq(Tri.TRUE, evaluator.evalPredicate(or, row(\"a\", T, \"x\", 0L)),\n                \"TRUE OR 1/0 -> TRUE, no error (short-circuit)\");\n        // OR 左值 FALSE -> 求值右值 -> 除零\n        expectThrowsEval(\"FALSE OR 1/0\", () ->\n                evaluator.evalPredicate(or, row(\"a\", F, \"x\", 0L)));\n        // OR 左值 UNKNOWN -> 求值右值 -> 除零（不短路）\n        expectThrowsEval(\"UNKNOWN OR 1/0\", () ->\n                evaluator.evalPredicate(or, row(\"a\", null, \"x\", 0L)));\n        // UNKNOWN OR FALSE -> UNKNOWN\n        Expr orFalse = Parser.parse(\"a OR (x = 2)\");\n        expectEq(Tri.UNKNOWN, evaluator.evalPredicate(orFalse, row(\"a\", null, \"x\", 1L)),\n                \"UNKNOWN OR FALSE -> UNKNOWN\");\n        // UNKNOWN OR TRUE -> TRUE\n        expectEq(Tri.TRUE, evaluator.evalPredicate(orFalse, row(\"a\", null, \"x\", 2L)),\n                \"UNKNOWN OR TRUE -> TRUE\");\n    }\n\n    private void nullComparisons() {\n        // NULL 参与任何比较都为 UNKNOWN：穷举六个比较符 x {op} y，其中左/右为 NULL\n        String[] ops = {\"=\", \"<>\", \"<\", \"<=\", \">\", \">=\"};\n        for (String op : ops) {\n            Expr leftNull = Parser.parse(\"x \" + op + \" 1\");\n            expectEq(Tri.UNKNOWN, evaluator.evalPredicate(leftNull, row(\"x\", null)),\n                    \"NULL \" + op + \" 1 -> UNKNOWN\");\n            Expr rightNull = Parser.parse(\"1 \" + op + \" x\");\n            expectEq(Tri.UNKNOWN, evaluator.evalPredicate(rightNull, row(\"x\", null)),\n                    \"1 \" + op + \" NULL -> UNKNOWN\");\n            Expr bothNull = Parser.parse(\"x \" + op + \" y\");\n            expectEq(Tri.UNKNOWN, evaluator.evalPredicate(bothNull, row(\"x\", null, \"y\", null)),\n                    \"NULL \" + op + \" NULL -> UNKNOWN (SQL: never TRUE, not even = )\");\n        }\n        // 非空整数比较的穷举小表（-1,0,1 两两组合，六种运算符）\n        long[] nums = {-1L, 0L, 1L};\n        for (long a : nums) {\n            for (long b : nums) {\n                expectEq(Tri.fromBoolean(a == b),\n                        evaluator.evalPredicate(Parser.parse(\"a = b\"), row(\"a\", a, \"b\", b)),\n                        a + \" = \" + b);\n                expectEq(Tri.fromBoolean(a != b),\n                        evaluator.evalPredicate(Parser.parse(\"a <> b\"), row(\"a\", a, \"b\", b)),\n                        a + \" <> \" + b);\n                expectEq(Tri.fromBoolean(a < b),\n                        evaluator.evalPredicate(Parser.parse(\"a < b\"), row(\"a\", a, \"b\", b)),\n                        a + \" < \" + b);\n                expectEq(Tri.fromBoolean(a <= b),\n                        evaluator.evalPredicate(Parser.parse(\"a <= b\"), row(\"a\", a, \"b\", b)),\n                        a + \" <= \" + b);\n expectOffset(LexException.class, \"99999999999999999999999\", 0, \"integer overflow lex\");\n\n        // 语法错误：未知标记的位置\n        expectOffset(ParseException.class, \"a AND )\", 6, \"unexpected points at operator\");\n        // 布尔排序：a < b 中 a 为布尔，错误指向 '<' 偏移 2\n        expectTypeError(\"a < flag\", 2, \"ordering boolean points at operator\");\n\n        // 求值期错误位置：指向具体运算节点\n        expectEvalOffset(\"9223372036854775807 + 1\", 19, \"overflow points at +\");\n        expectEvalOffset(\"1 / 0\", 2, \"division by zero points at /\");\n        expectEvalOffset(\"1 + 2 / 0\", 5,    + \" but got \" + ex.getClass().getSimpleName());\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    private void expectTypeError(String source, int expectedOffset, String label) {\n        Schema schema = DataType.STRING);\n        try {\n            new TypeChecker(schema).check(Parser.parse(source));\n            fail(label + \" — expected TypeException for <\" + source + \">\");\n        } catch expectOffset(LexException.class, \"'abc\", 0, \"unterminated string\");\n        // 整数字面量溢出（超过 Long.MAX 的最小数字串）\n        expectOffset(LexException.class, \"99999999999999999999999\", 0, \"integer <\");\n\n        // 类型错误：未知列指向列名起点\n        expectTypeError(\"unknown_col = 1\", 0, \"unknown column points at its name\");\n        // \"a AND 1\"：AND 右侧必须布尔，整数 1 的位置是 6\n        expectTypeError(\"a AND 1\", 6, \"non-boolean operand points at '1'\");\n        // 算术遇字符串：b + 'x' 中 'x' 偏移 4\n        expectTypeError(\"b + 'x'\", 4, \"string in arithmetic points at string literal\");\n        // 比较两侧类型不兼容：整数 = 字符串，错误指向 '=' 偏移 2\n        expectTypeError(\"b = 'x'\", 2, \"incompatible comparison points at operator\");\n        // 布尔排序：a < b 中 a 为布尔，错误指向 '<' 偏移 2\n        expectTypeError(\"a < flag\", 2, \"ordering boolean points at operator\");\n\n        // 求值期错误位置：指向具体运算节点（偏移从 0 计）\n        expectEvalOffset(\"9223372036854775807 + 1\", 20, \"overflow points at +\");\n        expectEvalOffset(\"1 / 0\", 2, \"division by zero points at /\");\n        expectEvalOffset(\"1 + 2 / 0\", 5, \"nested div zero points at /\");\n        expectEvalOffset(\"-(-9223372036854775808)\",   }\n        }\n    }\n\n    private void expectTypeError(String source, int expectedOffset, String label) {\n        Schema schema = new Schema();\n        schema.add(\"a\", DataType.BOOLEAN);\n        schema.add(\"flag\", DataType.BOOLEAN);\n        schema.add(\"b\", DataType.INTEGER);\n        schema.add(\"s\", DataType.STRING);\n        try {\n            new String label) {\n        try {\n            new Evaluator().evalPredicate(Parser.parse(source), row());\n            fail(label + \" — expected EvalException\");\n        } catch (EvalException ex) tvl.analyzer.DataType;\nimport tvl.analyzer.Schema;\nimport tvl.analyzer.TypeChecker;\nimport tvl.analyzer.TypeException;\nimport tvl.expr.Expr;\nimport tvl.parser.Parser;\n\n/** 类型检查器的接受/拒绝规则。 */\npublic class TypeCheckerTest extends TestBase {\n\n    private final Schema schema = buildSchema();\n\n    private static Schema buildSchema() {\n        Schema s = new Schema();\n        s.add(\"i\", DataType.INTEGER);\n        s.add(\"j\", DataType.INTEGER);\n        s.add(\"str\", DataType.STRING);\n        s.add(\"name\", DataType.STRING);\n        s.add(\"flag\", DataType.BOOLEAN);\n        return s;\n    }\n\n    @Override\n    public String name() {\n        return \"Type checker\";\n    }\n\n    @Override\n    public void run() {\n        // 合法表达式\n        accepts(\"i = j\", DataType.BOOLEAN);\n        accepts(\"i + j * 2 > 10\", DataType.BOOLEAN);\n        accepts(\"(i + j) IS NULL\", DataType.BOOLEAN);\n        accepts(\"str = 'x'\", DataType.BOOLEAN);\n        accepts(\"str < name\", DataType.BOOLEAN);\n        accepts(\"flag\", DataType.BOOLEAN);\n        accepts(\"flag AND i = 1\", DataType.BOOLEAN);\n        accepts(\"NOT (flag OR i <> j)\", DataType.BOOLEAN);\n        accepts(\"-i + 3\", DataType.INTEGER);\n        // 与 NULL/UNKNOWN 字面量组合\n        accepts(\"i = NULL\", DataType.BOOLEAN);\n        accepts(\"flag AND UNKNOWN\", DataType.NULL);\n        accepts(\"i + NULL\", DataType.NULL);\n        accepts(\"NOT NULL\", DataType.NULL);\n\n        // 非法表达式\n        rejects(\"str + 1\", \"string + integer\");\n        rejects(\"flag + 1\", \"boolean arithmetic\");\n        rejects(\"i = str\", \"integer vs string\");\n        rejects(\"flag = i\", \"boolean vs integer\");\n        rejects(\"flag < TRUE\", \"boolean ordered\");\n        rejects(\"i AND j\", \"integer in AND\");\n        rejects(\"NOT i\", \"NOT integer\");\n        rejects(\"str OR flag\", \"string in OR\");\n        rejects(\"missing_col = 1\", \"unknown column\");\n        rejects(\"i +\", \"syntax before type check still reported\");\n    }\n\n    private void accepts(String source, DataType expected) {\n        try {\n            DataType actual = new TypeChecker(schema).check(Parser.parse(source));\n            expectEq(expected, actual, \"accept <\" + source + \">\");\n        } catch (RuntimeException ex) {\n            fail(\"accept <\" + source + \"> but got \" + ex.getClass().getSimpleName()\n                    + \": \" + ex.getMessage());\n        }\n    }\n\n    private void rejects(String source, String label) {\n        Expr expr;\n        try {\n            expr = Parser.parse(source);\n        } catch (RuntimeException parseEx) {\n            check(true, label + \" (rejected at parse: \" + parseEx.getMessage() + \")\");\n            return;\n        }\n        try {\n            new TypeChecker(schema).check(expr);\n            fail(label + \" — expected TypeException for orExpr       := andExpr ( OR andExpr )*\n * andExpr      := notExpr ( AND notExpr )*\n * notExpr      := NOT notExpr | predicate\n * predicate    := comparison ( IS [NOT] NULL )?\n * comparison   := additive ((=|==|&lt;&gt;|!=|&lt;|&lt;=|&gt;|&gt;=) additive)?\n * additive     := term ((+ | -) term)*\n * term         := unary ((* | /) unary)*\n * unary        := -unary | primary\n * primary      := INTEGER | STRING | NULL | TRUE | FALSE | UNKNOWN | IDENT | '(' orExpr ')'\n * </pre>\n *\n * 不允许链式比较（如 {@code a < b < c}）；不允许比较结果做算术；\n * 这些约束的一部分在解析期发现，其余在类型检查期发现。\n */\npublic final class Parser {\n\n    private final String source;\n    private final Lexer lexer;\n    private Token current;\n\n    public Parser(String source) {\n        this.source = source;\n        this.lexer = new Lexer(source);\n        this.current = lexer.next();\n    }\n\n    public static Expr parse(String source) {\n        Parser p = new Parser(source);\n        Expr expr = p.parseOr();\n        if (p.current.type() != TokenType.EOF) {\n            throw new ParseException(\n                    \"unexpected token '\" + p.current.text() + \"' after complete expression\",\n                    p.current.pos());\n        }\n        return expr;\n    }\n\n    private Expr parseOr() {\n        Expr left = parseAnd();\n        while (current.type() == TokenType.OR) {\n            Token op = current;\n            advance();\n            Expr right = parseAnd();\n            left = new Expr.Logical(Expr.LogicalOp.OR, left, right, op.pos());\n        }\n        return left;\n    }\n\n    private Expr parseAnd() {\n        Expr left = parseNot();\n        while (current.type() == TokenType.AND) {\n            Token op = current;\n            advance();\n            Expr right = parseNot();\n            left = new Expr.Logical(Expr.LogicalOp.AND, left, right, op.pos());\n        }\n        return left;\n    }\n\n    private Expr parseNot() {\n        if (current.type() == TokenType.NOT) {\n            Token op = current;\n            advance();\n            return new Expr.Not(parseNot(), op.pos());\n        }\n        return parsePredicate();\n    }\n\n    private Expr parsePredicate() {\n        Expr expr = parseComparison();\n        if (current.type() == TokenType.IS) {\n            Token is = current;\n            advance();\n            boolean negated = false;\n            if (current.type() == TokenType.NOT) {\n                negated = true;\n                advance();\n            }\n            if (current.type() != TokenType.NULL) {\n = switch (current.type()) {\n            case EQ -> Expr.CompareOp.EQ;\n            case NE -> Expr.CompareOp.NE;\n            case LT -> Expr.CompareOp.LT;\n            case LE -> Expr.CompareOp.LE;\n            case GT -> Expr.CompareOp.GT;\n            case GE -> Expr.CompareOp.GE;\n            default -> null;\n        };\n        if (op == null) {\n            return left;\n        }\n        Token opToken = current;\n        advance();\n        Expr right = parseAdditive();\n        Expr comparison = new Expr.Compare(op, left, right, opToken.pos());\n        // combine them with AND?)\",\n                    current.pos());\n        }\n        return comparison;\n    }\n\n    private static boolean isComparisonOperator(TokenType t) {\n        return t == TokenType.EQ || t == TokenType.NE || t == TokenType.LT\n                || t == TokenType.LE || t == TokenType.GT || t == TokenType.GE;\n    }\n\n    private Expr parseAdditive() {\n        Expr left = parseTerm();\n        while (current.type() == TokenType.PLUS || current.type() == TokenType.MINUS) {\n            Token op = current;\n            advance();\n            Expr right = parseTerm();\n            Expr.ArithOp arithOp = op.type() == TokenType.PLUS\n                    ? Expr.ArithOp.ADD : Expr.ArithOp.SUB;\n            left = new Expr.BinaryArith(arithOp, left, right, op.pos());\n        }\n        return left;\n    }\n\n    private Expr parseTerm() {\n        Expr left = parseUnary();\n        while (current.type() == TokenType.STAR || current.type() == TokenType.SLASH) {\n            Token op = current;\n            advance();\n            Expr right = parseUnary();\n            Expr.ArithOp arithOp = op.type() == TokenType.STAR\n                    ? Expr.ArithOp.MUL : Expr.ArithOp.DIV;\n            left = new Expr.BinaryArith(arithOp, left, right, op.pos());\n        }\n        return left;\n    }\n\n    private Expr parseUnary() {\n        if (current.type() == TokenType.MINUS) {\n            Token op = current;\n            advance();\n            // 特殊处理边界字面量 -9223372036854775808\n            if (current.type() == TokenType.INTEGER\n                    && tvl.lexer.Lexer.MIN_LONG_DIGITS.equals(current.text())) {\n                advance();\n                return new Expr.Literal(Expr.LiteralKind.INTEGER, Long.MIN_VALUE, op.pos());\n            }\n            return new Expr.UnaryMinus(parseUnary(), op.pos());\n        }\n        if (current.type() == TokenType.PLUS) {\n            advance();\n            return parseUnary();\n        }\n        return parsePrimary();\n    }\n\n    private Expr parsePrimary() {\n        Token t = current;\n        switch (t.type()) {\n            case INTEGER -> {\n                advance();\n case FALSE -> {\n                advance();\n                return new Expr.Literal(Expr.LiteralKind.BOOLEAN, Boolean.FALSE, t.pos());\n            }\n            case UNKNOWN -> {\n                advance();\n                return new Expr.Literal(Expr.LiteralKind.UNKNOWN, null, t.pos());\n            }\n            case IDENT -> {\n                advance();\n                return new ')' to close parenthesised expression\");\n                return inner;\n            }\n            default -> throw new ParseException(\n                    \"unexpected token '\" + t.text() + \"', tvl.expr.Expr;\nimport tvl.expr.Tri;\n\n/**\n * 表达式求值器，实现 SQL 风格三值逻辑（3VL）。\n *\n * <p>关键语义：</p>\n * <ul>\n *   <li>NULL 参与任何比较结果为 UNKNOWN；NULL 参与算术结果为 NULL。</li>\n *   <li>{@code NOT UNKNOWN = UNKNOWN}。</li>\n *   <li>AND / OR 在结果已确定时短路：AND 左值为 FALSE 时不求右值；\n *       OR 左值为 TRUE 时不求右值。左值为 UNKNOWN 时结果仍取决于右值，\n *       因此必须继续求值（右值中的除零等错误仍会抛出）。</li>\n *   <li>{@code x IS NULL} 与 {@code x IS NOT NULL} 恒为 TRUE/FALSE，绝不返回 UNKNOWN。</li>\n *   <li>整数算术使用 {@link Math} 的精确运算：加/减/乘/一元负号溢出、除零均抛\n *       {@link EvalException}，错误位置定位到具体运算节点。</li>\n * </ul>\n *\n * 类型兼容性已由 {@code TypeChecker} 静态保证，求值期不再重复类型判断。\n */\npublic final class Evaluator {\n\n    /** 求值标量表达式，返回 Long / String / Boolean 或 null。 */\n    public Object evalScalar(Expr expr, RowLike row) {\n        return switch (expr) {\n            case Expr.Literal lit -> switch (lit.kind) {\n                case INTEGER -> lit.value;       // Long\n                case STRING -> lit.value;        // String\n                case BOOLEAN -> lit.value;       // Boolean\n                case NULL, UNKNOWN -> null;\n            };\n            case Expr.Column col -> row.get(col.name);\n            case Expr.UnaryMinus um -> {\n                Object v = evalScalar(um.operand, row);\n                if (v == null) yield null;\n                try {\n                    yield Math.negateExact((Long) v);\n                } catch (ArithmeticException ex) {\n                    throw new EvalException(\"integer overflow in unary '-'\", um.pos());\n                }\n            }\n            case Expr.BinaryArith arith -> {\n                Object l = evalScalar(arith.left, row);\n                if (l == null) yield null; // SQL: NULL 参与算术 => NULL（右值不需求值）\n                Object r = evalScalar(arith.right, row);\n                if (r == null) yield null;\n                yield evalArith(arith, (Long) l, (Long) r);\n            }\n            // 布尔语境节点不应走到标量求值\n            case Expr.Compare cmp -> triToNullableBoolean(evalCompare(cmp, row));\n            case Expr.IsNull isn -> triToNullableBoolean(evalIsNull(isn, row));\n            case Expr.Not not -> triToNullableBoolean(evalNot(not, row));\n            case Expr.Logical log -> triToNullableBoolean(evalLogical(log, row));\n        };\n    }\n\n    private static Boolean triToNullableBoolean(Tri tri) {\n        return switch (tri) {\n            case TRUE -> Boolean.TRUE;\n            case FALSE -> Boolean.FALSE;\n            case UNKNOWN -> null;\n        };\n    }\n\n    /** 求值布尔（谓词）表达式，返回三值逻辑真值。 */\n    public Tri evalPredicate(Expr expr, RowLike row) {\n        return switch (expr) {\n            case Expr.Literal lit -> switch (lit.kind) {\n                case BOOLEAN -> Tri.fromBoolean((Boolean) lit.value);\n                case NULL, UNKNOWN -> Tri.UNKNOWN;\n                default -> throw new EvalException(\"non-boolean literal used as predicate\",\n                        lit.pos());\n            };\n            case Expr.Column col -> {\n                Object v = row.get(col.name);\n                if (v == null) yield Tri.UNKNOWN;\n                yield Tri.fromBoolean((Boolean) v);\n            }\n            case Expr.Compare cmp -> evalCompare(cmp, row);\n            case Expr.IsNull isn -> evalIsNull(isn, row);\n            case Expr.Not not -> evalNot(not, row);\n            case Expr.Logical log -> evalLogical(log, row);\n            default -> throw new EvalException(\"non-boolean expression used as predicate\",\n                    expr.pos());\n        };\n    }\n\n    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    private Long evalArith(Expr.BinaryArith arith, long l, long r) {\n        try {\n            return switch (arith.op) {\n                case ADD -> Math.addExact(l, r);\n                case SUB -> Math.subtractExact(l, r);\n                case MUL -> Math.multiplyExact(l, r);\n                case DIV -> {\n                    if (r == 0L) {\n                        throw new ArithmeticException(\"division by zero\");\n                    }\n                    yield l / r; // 截断向零；Long.MIN_VALUE / -1 在 Java 下会抛 ArithmeticException\n                }\n            };\n        } catch (ArithmeticException ex) {\n            String detail = ex.getMessage() != null && ex.getMessage().contains(\"division\")\n                    ? \"division by zero\" : \"integer overflow\";\n            throw new EvalException(detail + \" in '\" + arith.op.symbol + \"'\", arith.pos());\n        }\n    }\n\n    private Tri evalCompare(Expr.Compare cmp, RowLike row) {\n        Object l = evalScalar(cmp.left, row);\n        if (l == null) return Tri.UNKNOWN;\n        Object r = evalScalar(cmp.right, row);\n        if (r == null) return Tri.UNKNOWN;\n\n        int cmpResult;\n        if (l instanceof Long ll && r instanceof Long rr) {\n            cmpResult = Long.compare(ll, rr);\n        } else if (l instanceof String ls && r instanceof String rs) {\n            cmpResult = ls.compareTo(rs);\n        } else if (l instanceof Boolean lb && r instanceof Boolean rb) {\n            // 仅 = / <> 可用于布尔（排序比较已在类型检查期拒绝）\n            cmpResult = Boolean.compare(lb, rb);\n        } else {\n            throw new EvalException(\n                    \"runtime type mismatch in comparison\", cmp.pos());\n        }\n\n        boolean result = switch (cmp.op) {\n            case EQ -> cmpResult == 0;\n            case NE -> cmpResult != 0;\n            case LT -> cmpResult < 0;\n            case LE -> cmpResult <= 0;\n            case GT -> cmpResult > 0;\n            case GE -> cmpResult >= 0;\n        };\n        return Tri.fromBoolean(result);\n    }\n\n    private Tri evalIsNull(Expr.IsNull isn, RowLike row) {\n        Object v = evalScalar(isn.operand, row);\n        boolean isNull = v == null;\n        return Tri.fromBoolean(isn.negated != isNull);\n    }\n\n    private Tri evalNot(Expr.Not not, RowLike row) {\n        Tri v = evalPredicate(not.operand, row);\n        return switch (v) {\n            case TRUE -> Tri.FALSE;\n            case FALSE -> Tri.TRUE;\n            case UNKNOWN -> Tri.UNKNOWN;\n        };\n    }\n\n    private Tri evalLogical(Expr.Logical log, RowLike row) {\n        Tri l = evalPredicate(log.left, row);\n        if (log.op == Expr.LogicalOp.AND) {\n            // 短路：左值 FALSE 已决定结果，右值绝不求值\n            if (l == Tri.FALSE) return Tri.FALSE;\n            Tri r = evalPredicate(log.right, row);\n            return andTruthTable(l, r);\n        } else {\n            // 短路：左值 TRUE 已决定结果，右值绝不求值\n            if (l == Tri.TRUE) return Tri.TRUE;\n            Tri r = evalPredicate(log.right, row);\n            return orTruthTable(l, r);\n        }\n    }\n\n    /** AND 三值真值表（此时左值只可能为 TRUE 或 UNKNOWN）。 */\n    static Tri andTruthTable(Tri l, Tri r) {\n        if (l == Tri.FALSE || r == Tri.FALSE) return Tri.FALSE;\n        if (l == Tri.TRUE && r == Tri.TRUE) return Tri.TRUE;\n        return Tri.UNKNOWN;\n    }\n\n    /** OR 三值真值表（此时左值只可能为 FALSE 或 UNKNOWN）。 */\n    static Tri orTruthTable(Tri l, Tri r) {\n        if (l == Tri.TRUE || r == Tri.TRUE) return Tri.TRUE;\n        if (l == Tri.FALSE && r == Tri.FALSE) return Tri.FALSE;\n        return Tri.UNKNOWN;\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":99,"oldLines":7,"newStart":99,"newLines":11,"lines":["                     if (r == 0L) {","                         throw new ArithmeticException(\"division by
